Dynamic Ignition.name: Dynamic Ignition
Dynamic Ignition.description:
You snap your fingers and point at a target, which begins to smolder.

1 You target an unoccupied square within 20 feet. Fires spring to life in the square, making it hazardous terrain that deals @Damage[(1+@item.rank)[fire]] damage to creatures that enter the area or end their turn in the area. The flames persist for [[/r 1d4]] rounds. If you cast the 1-action version of this spell again, your previous casting automatically ends.

2 You target a creature within 20 feet, making a spell attack roll against the target’s AC and dealing 2d4 fire damage on a hit, or double damage and an additional 1d4 persistent fire damage if you critically succeeded your spell attack roll. If the target is within your melee reach, you can choose to make a melee spell attack with the flame instead of a ranged spell attack, which increases all the spell's damage dice to d6s.

@Damage[(@item.rank)d4[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage}

@Damage[(@item.rank)d6[persistent,fire]]{Scaling Persistent Fire Damage (Melee)}

3 As the 2-action version, except spell’s range is 60 feet. Additionally, if the spell attack roll succeeds, the target takes 1d4 persistent fire damage.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the hazardous terrain from the 1-action version of the spell increases by 1. The initial damage and persistent fire damage of the spell’s 2-action and 3-action versions increases by 1d4.

Essence Spellcasting.name: Essence Spellcasting
Essence Spellcasting.description:
Instead of spell slots, you use essence to cast your spells, either through an incantation or through drawing and building up essence throughout a battle.

When using essence casting, you have a number of prepared spells or a spell repertoire as normal. However, you don’t spend spell slots to cast spells. Instead, you can cast spells from your prepared spells or repertoire only when you have essence equal to or greater than the spell’s rank, or via incantations. You cast focus spells and cantrips the same as normal, and they don’t require essence. Certain cantrips, called draw cantrips, can help you gain essence. Spells that normally require spell slots are called “essence spells” in this system of spellcasting.

Warping (Major).name: Warping (Major)
Warping (Major).description: Spells cast through a ring with this rune can arc and change at sharp angles, allowing you to avoid allies and hit enemies around corners. When you Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll spell, you can select up to three squares within 15 feet to be the new point of origin for the spell. The third square must be within 15 feet of the second square and the second square must be within 15 feet of the first square. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from there, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The target of the spell must still be within range of the chosen square.

Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf (M.name: Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf (Major)
Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf (M.description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (occult, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (occult, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Wicked.name: Wicked
Wicked.description:
Your ring shimmers with dark power, mocking those that fight for good.

Activate—Curse the Righteous R (unholy)

Trigger You successfully hit a holy creature with a spell modified by Veracious Spell.

You overpower the evil ways of your enemy. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the start of your next turn.

Fling Shadows.name: Fling Shadows
Fling Shadows.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon with the thrown trait.

Your shadows return to you when released from your grip. If your shadow weapon has the thrown trait, when you make a ranged Strike with the weapon it dissipates after the Strike and appears in the hand you used to make the Strike so long as it was made in the weapon’s first range increment.

Essence Pool.name: Essence Pool
Essence Pool.description: Every spellcaster’s body, mind, life force, and spirit can only hold so much essence before their vessel risks cracking, releasing the essence painfully if they attempt to hold more. All spellcasters train or self-study to avoid this, as in the worst case, they could experience great harm, lose their ability to cast magic, or even die. The size of a spellcaster’s essence pool is equal to the highest rank spell they can cast, with few exceptions beyond the most powerful spellcasters. An essence spellcaster’s essence pool begins at 1 and increases at 3rd level and every 2 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 9 at 17th level. A spellcaster’s essence pool doesn’t rise to 10 at 19th level, despite being able to cast 10th-rank spells.

Energy (Greater).name: Energy (Greater)
Energy (Greater).description:
Energy spells cause this ring to send a shimmering power through your hand.

Activate—Gather Power 1

Requirements Your last action was to Cast a Spell that dealt energy damage and was shaped by Veracious Spell;

You absorb some of the energy you are about to expel into your power ring. You hold a charge of Gathered Power in the ring of that energy type, up to a maximum of two charges. These charges last for 1 minute or until expelled by using Release Power.

Activate—Release Power 1 (attack)

Requirements You have a charge of Gathered Power in the ring;

You shoot a ray of power from stored up energy in the ring. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing @Damage[5d4] damage on a success or twice that amount on a critical success. You apply the ring’s item bonus to this spell attack roll. The damage is of the same damage type as the energy used to Gather Power and you expel the charge of energy from Gathered Power. You can expend two charges of the same energy type to increase the damage of Release Power to @Damage[10d4] damage.

Morph Summon.name: Morph Summon
Morph Summon.description:
Requirements You have a spell with the summon trait active that could have summoned another creature.

You alter the fabric of a summon and reshape it into something new. You Sustain the spell and then change the summoned creature to another creature the spell could have summoned with the required spell.

Special If the required spell is an aspect summon and you have Aspect Adept, you can instead morph the aspect summon into another aspect you could have cast with that spell.

Accelerated Dynamism.name: Accelerated Dynamism
Accelerated Dynamism.description:
You instantaneously prepare your mind and body to compress the casting time of one of your dynamic spells. You are quickened until the end of your turn. You can use this extra action only as a part of actions required to cast the three-action version of a spell with which you have dynamic mastery.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.fctqmyLME0fTvHMa]{Triplicate Casting} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.5jxyCBmg3f5p4Vf0]{Variable Preparation} archetype feat, you can also use the extra action as one of the three actions required for Triplicate Casting or for casting the internal spell with Variable Preparation.

Energy (Major).name: Energy (Major)
Energy (Major).description:
Energy spells cause this ring to send a shimmering power through your hand.

Activate—Gather Power 1

Requirements Your last action was to Cast a Spell that dealt energy damage and was shaped by Veracious Spell;

You absorb some of the energy you are about to expel into your power ring. You hold a charge of Gathered Power in the ring of that energy type, up to a maximum of three charges. These charges last for 1 minute or until expelled by using Release Power.

Activate—Release Power 1 (attack)

Requirements You have a charge of Gathered Power in the ring;

You shoot a ray of power from stored up energy in the ring. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing @Damage[5d4] damage on a success or twice that amount on a critical success. You apply the ring’s item bonus to this spell attack roll. The damage is of the same damage type as the energy used to Gather Power and you expel the charge of energy from Gathered Power. You can expend two or three charges of the same energy type to increase the damage of Release Power to @Damage[10d4] or @Damage[15d4] damage respectively.

Blue Salt Crystal.name: Blue Salt Crystal
Blue Salt Crystal.description:
Activate Cast a Spell

This crystal of salt is as blue as the deep ocean. Adding this catalyst to a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.lwVCVebn7s4qHFWg]{Drown} transforms the summoned water into deadly brine, causing the target to take @Damage[@item.level[persistent,acid]] damage for the duration of the spell equal to the rank of the spell.

Entertainer.name: Entertainer
Entertainer.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.92lgSEPFIDLvKOCF]{Accompanist}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.cT5octWchU4gjrhP]{Manual Dexterity} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Perform)

Your familiar is an entertainer and knows how to put on a show.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.tg93Tw6KBAolQQsz]{Advanced Entertainer} You can command your familiar to spend 2 actions to Perform, comparing its result to the Will DC of one observer. If your familiar succeeds, the target is fascinated by it for 1 round. If the observer is in a situation that demands immediate attention, such as combat, your familiar must critically succeed to fascinate it and the Perform action gains the incapacitation trait. You must choose which creature your familiar is trying to fascinate before the check is rolled, and the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Targeted Ward.name: Targeted Ward
Targeted Ward.description:
You prepare your defenses against a specific foe, shrouding them in a cloak of divinatory magic that allows you to react to their past actions, focus sharply on their present actions, or peer slightly into their future. You gain a status bonus to your choice of AC, Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, or Will saves against that opponent based on the results of the opponent’s Will save. The number of actions you spend determines when the bonus applies.

Critical Success You do not gain a bonus.

Success The status bonus is +1.

Failure The status bonus is +2.

Critical Failure The status bonus is +3.

1 The range is 30 feet. You focus on a specific action the opponent has taken in the past, such as a breath weapon or a Strike. The bonus only applies when the opponent uses that same action against you.

2 The range is 30 feet, and the bonus applies every time that opponent targets your chosen defense.

3 As the two-action version, except the range is 60 feet. Additionally, when the opponent uses an offensive ability against you that targets a different defense (such as targeting your AC after you have chosen to gain a status bonus to Fortitude saves), you can change your defense to match the one appropriate for the incoming attack as a free action. Once you have changed the defense type once, you can’t change it again during the same casting of targeted ward.

Heightened (5th) Increase the status bonuses granted by each result by 1 (including granting a +1 status bonus on a critical success).

Magic Tome (1st-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (1st-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (1st-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Magic Chalice (4th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (4th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (4th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 4th-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Untamed Form+.name: Untamed Form+
Untamed Form+.description: You are one with the wild, always changing and adapting to meet any challenge. You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift} order spell, which lets you transform into a variety of shapes that you can expand with druid feats.

Haemomantic Training.name: Haemomantic Training
Haemomantic Training.description:
Blood is blood, as they say, and even without having as much of a focus on mixing blood with traditional magic, you’ve been able to pick up a trick or two. You gain one feat from the haemothurge archetype that isn’t Haemothurge Dedication that you qualify for. For the purpose of meeting its prerequisites, your level is equal to half your character level and you are considered to have the Haemothurge Dedication.

Special You can select this feat more than once. Each time you select it, you gain another haemothurge feat.

Dynamic Invisibility.name: Dynamic Invisibility
Dynamic Invisibility.description:
Illusions bend light around the target, rendering it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.zJxUflt9np0q4yML]{Invisible}. This makes it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} to all creatures, though the creatures can attempt to find the target, making it @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} to them instead. If the target uses a hostile action, the spell ends after that hostile action is completed.

1 You can only target yourself, and the spell lasts until the end of your next turn.

2 The spell has a range of touch and lasts for 1 minute.

3 The spell has a range of touch and lasts for 1 minute. The first time that the target uses a hostile action, instead of becoming fully visible, they partially reappear. They are concealed for the duration or until the target uses a hostile action again.

Heightened (4th) The duration of the 2-action version decreases to 3 rounds, but the spell doesn’t end if the target uses a hostile action.

Summon Ooze Aspect.name: Summon Ooze Aspect
Summon Ooze Aspect.description:
You call upon an ooze to aid you. You summon an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.HqRDK6jf5vAVwt2l]{ooze aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.yRcCXxoHCNGSWSh0]{Ooze Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.SlQSir9DtX0rI0lA]{Spell Effect: Ooze Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.PP7f16PmxFqgNgPM]{Summon Ooze Aspect}

Summon Animal Aspect.name: Summon Animal Aspect
Summon Animal Aspect.description:
You call upon an animal to do your bidding. You summon an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.3K8036kor5oCkGQ5]{animal aspect} that can be up to Medium in size (or a different size, as determined by your choice of aspect).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.2uDnYIc16jKJdPK1]{Animal Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.TLIkcaSk5Zx3iFjK]{Spell Effect: Animal Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.Macro.ZQhSg2pV8enjw4Rg]

Magic Tome (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (3rd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Fiend Shift.name: Fiend Shift
Fiend Shift.description:
You transform into a daemon, demon, devil, or velstrac. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.zTdtg6CPxmqwus1D]{fiend aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.NtuTEQoDNpPqOkUL]{Spell Effect: Fiend Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Spill Their Blood.name: Spill Their Blood
Spill Their Blood.description: You cause the blood of many to flow with ease. You can use Bleeding Spell with spells that would target multiple creatures, dealing persistent damage equal to the rank of the spell to all creatures targeted by the spell that failed their save or that you successfully make a spell attack roll against.

Colossal Aspect Form.name: Colossal Aspect Form
Colossal Aspect Form.description: You assume the form of an enormous creature. If your next action is to cast an aspect battle form spell of 10th-rank, your form is Gargantuan in size and takes up 6 squares by 6 squares (30 feet by 30 feet) and you are 100 feet tall and your reach increases to 25 feet. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.XVveTQK3RY2w72XL]{Trample} activity, or increase the damage dice of your aspect’s Trample by one size if it already had the Trample activity.

prerequisites.value: You know at least one aspect battle form spell

Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword (Major).name: Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword (Major)
Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Archmage's Curse.name: Archmage's Curse
Archmage's Curse.description: The curse of an archmage is akin to being shunned and despised by magic itself. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.hhYyD33wnQbdsP0N]{Silence of The Archmage} focus spell.

Boom-a-rang.name: Boom-a-rang
Boom-a-rang.description:
You conjure a boomerang of howling winds, then toss it at your foes. The boomerang sails from your hand to the end of the line.

1 The boomerang deals no damage on the initial throw. On your next turn, you can Sustain the spell to bring the boomerang back to your location. All creatures in that returning line take 2d8 sonic damage, with a basic Reflex save.

2 As the 1-action version, except that the boomerang also harms creatures as soon as you throw it. Creatures in the line when you throw the boomerang also take 2d8 slashing damage, with a basic Reflex save.

3 As the 2-action version, but the boomerang automatically returns to your location at the beginning of your next turn, without you having to Sustain it, and the sonic damage of the returning boomerang is increased to 2d10.

Heightened (+1) Increase the sonic damage of the returning boomerang by 1d8 for the 1-action version and 2-action versions and by 1d10 for the 3-action version. Increase the slashing damage from the 2-action and 3-action versions by 1d8.

Magic Amulet (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (3rd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 3rd-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Chimerize Aspects.name: Chimerize Aspects
Chimerize Aspects.description:
You can create creatures that bend the laws of reality. When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.dUn3jYgzHpY8eGjO]{Fuse Aspects}, you can select from the following effects instead of the normal effects:

  • You fuse three aspects of the same aspect summon spell rather than just one.

  • You fuse two aspects from different aspect summon spells rather than just one.

prerequisites.value:
You know at least three aspect
summons

Essence Conduit.name: Essence Conduit
Essence Conduit.description: Starting at 3rd level, you can use an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GMpbfdVHBUaiIwSy]{action} to make yourself into a conduit for magical essences, ensuring a healthy essence cycle.

Ooze Shift.name: Ooze Shift
Ooze Shift.description:
You transform into an ooze. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.HqRDK6jf5vAVwt2l]{ooze aspect} to become your aspect battle form.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.SlQSir9DtX0rI0lA]{Spell Effect: Ooze Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Alaznist's Embrace.name: Alaznist's Embrace
Alaznist's Embrace.description: The runelord Alaznist was an expert in explosive and destructive magics, and she developed this technique to enhance the devastation her magic caused. Whenever you deal Hit Point damage to an enemy with a spell that deals acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage, the affected enemy has weakness 10 to that damage type until the end of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.KEa3AvPJPdWK4Mx4]{Effect: Alaznist's Embrace}

Variable Preparation.name: Variable Preparation
Variable Preparation.description: Through extensive study of dynamic spells, you’ve developed a method for overlaying a spell with another spell. For each rank of spells you can prepare, you can choose one of your spell slots becomes a hybrid spell slot. Prepare two different two-action spells into that slot, choosing one to be the external spell and one to be the internal spell. You can cast the external spell or spend a bit of extra effort to peel off the external spell to cast the internal spell. When you use that spell slot, you can either cast the external spell for two actions as normal, or cast the internal spell by spending three actions.

Steady Support.name: Steady Support
Steady Support.description:
This small piece of polished lodestone or magnetite is shaped like a tripod, and will make you sturdier when activated.

Activate R

Trigger You are targeted with an effect that would cause forced movement

Your feet are firmly stuck to the ground and your stance is more stable. You gain a +2 item bonus to DCs and checks against forced movement until the end of your next turn.

Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance.name: Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance
Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Colossal Summon.name: Colossal Summon
Colossal Summon.description:
You summon a creature so immense it towers. If your next action is to cast a summon spell of 10th-rank with the summon trait that summons a creature, the creature gains the listed abilities in addition to the ones it already possessed.

Colossal The summon takes up a space of 6 squares by 6 squares (30 feet by 30 feet) and is 100 feet tall. All of its speeds increase by 20 feet, and it gains the Trample activity, or increases the damage dice of its Trample by one size if it already had the Trample activity.

Earth-Shatterer 2 Frequency once per minute; Effect The summon produces the effects of an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.x7SPrsRxGb2Vy2nu]{Earthquake}.

Megalophobia (aura 100 feet, emotion, fear, mental) Even looking up at the summon causes vertigo, like you might fall upwards into the sky. A creature that enters or begins its turn within the emanation must succeed at a Will save or the creature is frightened 2 (frightened 3 and fleeing on a critical failure). Creatures frightened by this ability treat all squares in the area as difficult terrain. Regardless of the result, creatures are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Expert Essence Spellcasting.name: Expert Essence Spellcasting
Expert Essence Spellcasting.description:
Instead of the normal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#expert-spellcasting-feat]{Expert Spellcasting Feat}, when using essence casting, the expert spellcasting benefits are as follows: You become an expert in spell attack rolls and spell DCs. You gain a 3rd-rank spell slot, and your essence draw increases to 2 and your maximum essence pool increases to 3 if they were lower. If you have a spell repertoire, you can select a second spell from your repertoire as a signature spell. At 14th level, you gain a 4th-rank spell slot, and your essence draw increases to 3 and your maximum essence pool increases to 4 if they were lower. At 16th level, you gain a 5th-rank spell slot, and your essence draw increases to 4 and your maximum essence pool increases to 5 if they were lower.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.gWcA65AL89Y9Bcxr]{Essence Spellcasting Archetypes}

Inescapable Shadows.name: Inescapable Shadows
Inescapable Shadows.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon.

Your shadows know no bounds and enemies are always within reach of your weapons as long as they tread where darkness lies. Make a melee Strike with your shadow weapon against an enemy within 30 feet that has a shadow, choosing a square adjacent to the target as the point of origin for the Strike for the purposes of flanking. The target’s shadow then dissipates for 1 minute.

Advanced Scientific.name: Advanced Scientific
Advanced Scientific.description: Your familiar gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Crafting) and its choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.ModT5b0jvnaitzJH]{Extra Alchemy} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.ZtKb89o1PPhwJ3Lx]{Extra Vial} abilities, but you must select alchemical bombs if your familiar’s forbisen choice was alchemical gut and you must select an alchemical poisons if it was poison reservoir for these abilities.

Magic Bell (9th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (9th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (9th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 9th-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Summon Thurse Aspect.name: Summon Thurse Aspect
Summon Thurse Aspect.description:
You call to a mighty being for aid, like a giant or a beast. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.YnKV7I548K8EH9JW]{thurse aspect} that can be up to Medium in size (or a different size, as determined by your choice of aspect).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.h2IRWNyNrZFvZH1N] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.RhhDWeuA1RBPLy1W]{Spell Effect: Thurse Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.qZXl8R1poCgLyMUz]{Summon Thurse Aspect}

Aspect Caller Dedication.name: Aspect Caller Dedication
Aspect Caller Dedication.description:
You are an aspect caller, a caster who specializes in summoning raw magic and reforming it through aspects to become any creature imaginable. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.cmPXzjIHh1WSoPlP]{Summon Accomplice} focus as a spell of the tradition you used to qualify for this archetype. During your daily preparations, choose a spell with the summon trait that summons a creature you can cast with spell slots for your summon accomplice. You can recover a Focus Point by using the Refocus activity by focusing on your connection to summons.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.UxdYVCXlWwAnKS8U]{Aspect Caller Archetype}

prerequisites.value: You can cast spells from spell slots and know at least one spell with the summon trait

Charging Form.name: Charging Form
Charging Form.description: You burst into action, moving as your form emerges. You Cast a Spell that takes 2 actions or less to cast with the polymorph trait that targets yourself and then immediately Stride.

Thirsty Blade.name: Thirsty Blade
Thirsty Blade.description:
Cost 2 sanguimancy Hit Points per weapon damage die

Requirements You are wielding a weapon.

You touch a weapon, coating it in a thin layer of your blood. The required weapon deals bleed damage equal to its number of weapon damage dice, and on a critical hit against a creature not immune to bleed damage, you gain sanguimancy Hit Points equal to the number of weapon damage dice of the required weapon. These benefits last until the end of your next turn.

Immobilizing.name: Immobilizing
Immobilizing.description: When you blast magic from a hand wearing this ring, it encrusts the enemy in magical ice, stone, or wood. Each rune specializes in either cold, earth, shadow, or wood, and the rune gains that trait. When you critically succeed at a spell attack roll with a spell that has no duration and has the trait of the rune, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[dc:24|type:fortitude] save.

Ranged Resonance.name: Ranged Resonance
Ranged Resonance.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your Mystic Link boosts your magic’s range. When you Cast a Spell with no duration, you can choose to use your or your mystic duo’s position for the purposes of determining the point of casting for the spell.

Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier (Greater).name: Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier (Greater)
Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier (Greater).description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, force) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[force]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, force) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[force]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Ramming (Greater).name: Ramming (Greater)
Ramming (Greater).description: Ramming rings shoot foes rocketing away. Spell attacks gain the razing trait. On a critically successful spell attack against a creature, the target must also make a @Check[dc:32|type:fortitude] save or be pushed back 20 feet from the origin of the spell.

Embodiment.name: Embodiment
Embodiment.description:
Your ring swirls with the malleable magical essences. When you Cast a Spell with the polymorph trait that grants a battle form, you gain a status bonus to Strikes equal to the ring’s item bonus until the spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.hjaV1ZsR703KtEli]

Magic Bell (7th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (7th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (7th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 7th-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Celestial Shift.name: Celestial Shift
Celestial Shift.description:
You transform into a celestial, like an agathion, angel, archon, or azata. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.ABdvu7T0B57zoJRm]{celestial aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GNSz5ksf9fux0j7u]

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Howl of Winter (Major).name: Howl of Winter (Major)
Howl of Winter (Major).description:
Activate 2 Interact, Strike

This spellgun somehow appears to be a naturally-formed pistol shaped icicle. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. This spellgun has a range increment of 30 feet. The spellgun blasts bone-chilling arctic wind that deals @Damage[16d6[cold]] damage, then melts.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 minute.

Success As critical success, except the target takes full damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty.

Terminus of Ultima.name: Terminus of Ultima
Terminus of Ultima.description: At 19th level, you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.QPAQqTXsHbrLHKhp]{Terminus of Ultima} free action and a 10th-rank spell slot you can only cast when you use Terminus of Ultima. You can also cast a 10th-rank spell as a long incantation once per day, though it takes 3 hours to do so instead of 1; you can’t cast 10th-rank spells with normal incantations as they are beyond your essence pool.

Contingency of The Archmage.name: Contingency of The Archmage
Contingency of The Archmage.description: To be unprepared is to be dead, and an archmage is never unprepared. Choose one 4th-rank spell that affects you with a casting time no more than 3 actions. Each day, you gain the effects of a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.WG91Z5TiR6oO5FOw]{Contingency} spell as if you had Cast the Spell with the spell you selected for this feat. You choose the trigger for the spell during your daily preparations.

Ally Form.name: Ally Form
Ally Form.description: You send supernatural power into your companion, igniting them into a mystic battle form. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots that would grant you a battle form, you can target an adjacent willing ally instead of yourself with the spell. You or the ally can Dismiss the spell and the spell’s duration is reduced to 1 minute if it would be longer than 1 minute.

Archmage's Triumph.name: Archmage's Triumph
Archmage's Triumph.description:
Your ultimate achievement as an archmage is the spellcraft. You gain an additional 10th-rank spell slot that can only be used to cast this spell. Your spell requires 2 actions to cast and has the concentrate, manipulate, and mythic traits. It must fit within the following parameters, which are chosen when you first gain this feat and cannot be changed later except by retraining this feat.

  • The spell must allow either a Fortitude or Reflex saving throw (your choice; typically, Fortitude is used for cold and sonic spells while Reflex is used for acid, electricity and fire.)

  • The spell targets one of the following areas: 120-foot line, 60-foot cone, 45-foot emanation, or a 30-foot burst within 240 feet. Alternatively, you can choose to target up to 5 creatures within 120 feet of you, no two of which can be 30 feet apart.

  • The spell deals one of the following damage types and gains the matching trait: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. It deals damage in one of the following amounts with a basic saving throw: 14d12, 17d10, or 24d6. Optionally, you can choose to have the spell deal two types of damage from this list, reducing its total damage by two dice and dealing half of its damage as each energy type (for example, if you chose 24d6 for the damage amount and want it to deal both acid and fire damage, it would instead deal 12d6 acid and 12d6 fire.)

  • Creatures that fail their save against this spell gain one of the following conditions, which each last for 1 minute: enfeebled 2, clumsy 2, or stupefied 2.

You can name your spell whatever you want, but most archmages choose to include their name somewhere in the spell, such as Eobard’s energy cascade. Any spellcaster capable of casting 10th-rank spells can learn this spell from you via the Learn a Spell activity.

As long as a spellcaster somewhere in the world knows this spell, you can never truly die. When your physical body dies, you hide your soul away inside this spell’s record in the Akashic Library. The next time a spellcaster casts this spell, you siphon some of the ambient energy it draws in to recreate a new physical body somewhere within 1 mile of the spellcasting. As long as the equipment you had on you when you died is still with your corpse, you reappear with half your total maximum Hit Points, all your spell slots available, and your equipment. If your corpse has been looted since your death, you appear in the same fashion but without your clothing and equipment.

Spellshaping Paragon.name: Spellshaping Paragon
Spellshaping Paragon.description:
You are uniquely skilled at the manipulation of magical energies and can prepare magical shortcuts and adjustments to suit any situation. Each day when you prepare or regain your spells, choose one of the following spellshape feats that you don’t already have: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.bVng7Mkrj4UnQzLo]{Burning Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.sIeuPW0j39fTZm08]{Conceal Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.nroOy0PBeEUGdUXD]{Dousing Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.riQ8sn3Gpbr3LdtR]{Gusting Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.BWomK7EVY0WXxWgh]{Reach Spell}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.U9SrWgLJ8JoAKIy0]{Rockslide Spell}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.FoWO4RnHRwfEIC7Q]{Widen Spell}. You gain that feat until your next daily preparations.

Special You can spend a Mythic Point as an Interact action to rewrite your own magic and swap the chosen feat with another feat from the above list.

Archmemory.name: Archmemory
Archmemory.description:
Your mastery of the highest magics allows you to recall spells that have been cast and purged from your mind by instantly recreating the symbology necessary for their effects. If your last action this turn was to Cast a Spell, or if the last activity you used this turn included Casting a Spell, you instantly regain the spell slot expended to Cast that Spell.

Special If you are an essence caster, instead of the normal effect of this feat, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GMpbfdVHBUaiIwSy]{Essence Conduit} as a free action once per day.

Fiendlorn's Possession.name: Fiendlorn's Possession
Fiendlorn's Possession.description:
The archmage Mesandroth Fiendlorn was a necromancer of immense power, obsessed with achieving immortality. You have mastered a form of immortality based on one of his darker techniques. You mark a living creature of 15th-level or lower as your heir; you must come in physical contact with the designated creature, though even a simple brush of your hand will suffice. Once a creature has been designated as your heir, your spirit can find them no matter where they are, even if they try to escape to another plane or planet. In the event of your death, your spirit is drawn to your heir and steals their body, making it your own. You retain all the spells, character levels, and other abilities you possessed before your death, though you now have your heir’s physical appearance and belongings.

You can attempt to use Fiendlorn’s Possession on an angel, demon, devil, or monitor, but it is more difficult to do so. You must come into firm contact with the creature with an Interact action, at which point they can immediately attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.spellDC.value)] save against your spell DC. On a success, your attempt fails and that creature is immune to all future uses of Fiendlorn’s Possession. On a failure, the creature becomes your heir. If you then take possession of them (typically by dying), you gain all the traits that creature possessed in addition to your own, along with any resistances, weaknesses, special actions or abilities, movement types and speeds, and any innate spells. You otherwise use your own stats and attributes. You become immune to old age and do not die from natural causes, but can never use Fiendlorn’s Possession again on another creature.

You cannot have more than one heir at a time via this ability. An heir seeking to free themselves from Fiendlorn’s Possession before you claim their body as your own must successfully counteract the effect with a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.SUKaxVZW2TlM8lu0]{Cleanse Affliction} spell heightened to 10th-rank; a lower-rank casting will have no effect.

Messenger Accomplice.name: Messenger Accomplice
Messenger Accomplice.description: When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.cmPXzjIHh1WSoPlP]{Summon Accomplice}, you can choose to summon a messenger aspect, a special @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.3DSNbxe36dMAwXpC]{animal aspect}, that extends the duration to 10 minutes and reduces the Hit Points of the summoned creature by half. When you do so, the spell does not need to be sustained to remain in effect (though you must still Sustain the spell to give your summon actions). The summon will not fight for you, but you can have it perform small tasks such as fetching something for you, spying on someone, or delivering something.

Conspirator Dragonbreath Dagger (Major).name: Conspirator Dragonbreath Dagger (Major)
Conspirator Dragonbreath Dagger (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (occult, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (occult, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Dynamic Electric Arc.name: Dynamic Electric Arc
Dynamic Electric Arc.description:
You call forth electricity, charging up your targets or zapping them with leaping lightning.

1 The spell affects one target within 15 feet, turning it into an electrified lightning rod. The next time within the next minute that any creature within 15 feet of the electrified creature takes electricity damage and the electrified creature would not take electricity damage, the electricity arcs over to the electrified creature, dealing 1d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

2 Choose one or two targets within 15 feet. Each target takes 2d4 electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

3 The spell’s range is 30 feet. You can cause the lightning to leap from the first target to the second one, allowing the second target to be anywhere within 30 feet of the first target even if it is out of the spell’s range.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the one-action version increases by 1. The damage of the two-action and three-action versions increases by 1d4.

Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier.name: Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier
Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Spell and Steel.name: Spell and Steel
Spell and Steel.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active and your mystic duo made a successful Strike since your last turn.

You and your mystic duo have spent time honing your combat prowess as well as your connection, allowing you to take advantage of openings they create. If your next action is to Cast a Spell with no duration that deals damage, the spell gains a status bonus to damage equal to twice the rank of the spell or equal to the rank of the spell if the spell was a cantrip. This damage is of the same type as your mystic duo’s weapon would deal and applies only to the initial damage the spell deals when cast. An individual creature takes this damage only once per spell, even if the spell would damage that creature multiple times.

Ardor.name: Ardor
Ardor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of poetry and wordplay.

Wicket Traits auditory, emotion

Tethered Magic When you Cast a Spell with the auditory or emotion trait that targets a single creature within your wicket's dominion, you can also target another one within it. All numerical effects, such as duration, damage, or healing, are halved. If the spell requires a save, both creatures gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their save and the duration of any condition or effect of the spell is reduced by half (minimum 1 round).

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the auditory trait on a creature immune to auditory effects, you translate the effect to another sense, bypassing its immunity to auditory. The creature must have at least one other sense to bypass its immunity. When you Cast a Spell with the emotion trait on a creature immune to emotion effects, the target is affected for 1 round as if it could feel emotions normally.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the emotion trait
Access to at least one spell with the auditory trait

Advanced Wordsmith.name: Advanced Wordsmith
Advanced Wordsmith.description: When your familiar Aids you on a check, you can choose to forgo the circumstance bonus it grants to instead roll the check twice, once with your modifier and once with your familiar’s modifier to the triggering check, using the higher of the results as your result. This is a fortune effect.

Ultima Ad Infinitum.name: Ultima Ad Infinitum
Ultima Ad Infinitum.description: You can cast your ultimate spell more often without endangering yourself. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.QPAQqTXsHbrLHKhp]{Terminus of Ultima} gains a cycle 2, with the same effects as cycle 1.

prerequisites.value: Essence Weaver Dedication, Terminus of Ultima

Omen Dragonbreath Scythe (Greater).description:

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Magic Bell (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (3rd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 3rd-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Summon Celestial Aspect.name: Summon Celestial Aspect
Summon Celestial Aspect.description:
You call a celestial force to do your bidding. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.ABdvu7T0B57zoJRm]{celestial aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.XwCNmhi9qFUDqfYW]{Celestial Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GNSz5ksf9fux0j7u]{Spell Effect: Celestial Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.5XcIPo95buZhwrzv]{Summon Celestial Aspect}

Localized Eclipse.name: Localized Eclipse
Localized Eclipse.description:
You draw a curtain of darkness over the celestial firmament. In the area, bright light becomes dim light and dim light becomes darkness. The first time you Sustain the spell each turn, you can move the area to another location within 30 feet.

Heightened (+1) You increase the area of the burst by 5 feet.

Magic Bell (1st-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (1st-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (1st-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 1st-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Thousand-Year Flood.name: Thousand-Year Flood
Thousand-Year Flood.description:
Area (continued) 100-foot radius, 50-foot-tall cylinder

You conjure forth a near-mythical deluge of water. The deluge has the following effects:

  • The area is filled with water, which is greater difficult terrain to all creatures without a swim Speed and difficult terrain for creatures with a swim Speed. Creatures in the area that cannot breathe in water must hold their breath or immediately begin drowning.

  • When you initially Cast the Spell, creatures in the area are tossed about by the rushing water, taking 10d10 bludgeoning damage with a basic Reflex save.

  • The water deals 20d12 damage to structures and unattended objects in the area or half this amount if the structure or object is magical.

  • The first time each round you Sustain this spell, you can spend an action to attack a creature in the area with debris and rushing water, making a spell attack roll against their AC and dealing 9d4 bludgeoning damage on a success, or double damage on a critical success.

Special If you are a follower of a deity with the water domain, you can choose to give this spell the sanctified trait.

Scientific.name: Scientific
Scientific.description:
Prerequisites You must have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.yzNJgwzV9XqEhKc6]{Quick Alchemy} to select this forbisen.

Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Rv1KTRioaZOWyQI6]{Alchemical Gut} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.8Z1UkLEWkFWIjOF8]{Poison Reservoir}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.7QosmRHlyLLhU1hX]{Lab Assistant}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.cT5octWchU4gjrhP]{Manual Dexterity}

Your familiar is exceptional in the field of alchemy.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.6bH6g4uCWjqM81AQ]{Advanced Scientific} Your familiar gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Crafting) and its choice of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.ModT5b0jvnaitzJH]{Extra Alchemy} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.ZtKb89o1PPhwJ3Lx]{Extra Vial} abilities, but you must select alchemical bombs if your familiar’s forbisen choice was alchemical gut and you must select an alchemical poisons if it was poison reservoir for these abilities.

Summon Fiend Aspect.name: Summon Fiend Aspect
Summon Fiend Aspect.description:
You bind a fiend to do your bidding. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.zTdtg6CPxmqwus1D]{fiend aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.d0cX3r5XBLoC9Aan] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.NtuTEQoDNpPqOkUL]{Spell Effect: Fiend Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.BWW9xQ4rGI81L4KI]

Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword (Greate.name: Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword (Greater)
Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword (Greate.description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Magic Amulet (5th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (5th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (5th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 5th-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Power Ring (Platinum).name: Power Ring (Platinum)
Power Ring (Platinum).description:
This seemingly simple metal band glows with mystic heat when magic travels through your fingers. You can add special ring runes to a power ring to further heighten your mastery over magic. When activated, it imbues your attack spells with increased accuracy. During your daily preparations, choose up to 5 cantrips you can cast that would require a spell attack roll. The cantrips you chose can ignore the frequency of the ring’s activation. You can imbue three ring runes into the ring.

When you invest the ring, you either increase your spellcasting attribute modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher score.

Activate—Veracious Spell f (flourish, manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

The ring’s magic guides your attack. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would require a spell attack roll, you gain a +2 item bonus to your spell attack roll. If the spell has multiple targets, the bonus applies to all of them. If a spell you modified with this effect could make additional spell attack rolls on a Sustain, the item bonus applies to these spell attack rolls as well.

Dynamic Vampiric Feast.name: Dynamic Vampiric Feast
Dynamic Vampiric Feast.description:
Your magic leeches the lifeblood out of a target to empower yourself.

1 You gather void energy into your hand, ready to augment your next spell with vampiric power. The next time you Cast a Spell before the end of your next turn, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the damage a single creature takes from this spell; calculate these temporary Hit Points using the creature that took the most damage (to a maximum of [[5*@item.rank]] temporary Hit Points). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 3 rounds.

2 You touch a target, dealing them 6d6 void damage. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to half the void damage the target takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 3 rounds.

3 As the 2-action version of the spell, but the range increases from touch to 60 feet and the temporary Hit Points can last for up to 1 minute.

Heightened (+1) The maximum number of temporary Hit Points that can be gained from the 1-action version of the spell increases by 5. The damage of the spell’s 2-action and 3-action versions increases by 2d6.

Power Ring (Silver).name: Power Ring (Silver)
Power Ring (Silver).description:
This seemingly simple metal band glows with mystic heat when magic travels through your fingers. You can add special ring runes to a power ring to further heighten your mastery over magic. When activated, it imbues your attack spells with increased accuracy. During your daily preparations, choose up to 3 cantrips you can cast that would require a spell attack roll. The cantrips you chose can ignore the frequency of the ring’s activation. You can imbue two ring runes into the ring.

Activate—Veracious Spell f (flourish, manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

The ring’s magic guides your attack. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would require a spell attack roll, you gain a +2 item bonus to your spell attack roll. If the spell has multiple targets, the bonus applies to all of them. If a spell you modified with this effect could make additional spell attack rolls on a Sustain, the item bonus applies to these spell attack rolls as well.

Magic Tome (6th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (6th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (6th-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Resilient Dismissal.name: Resilient Dismissal
Resilient Dismissal.description:
Trigger You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You are in a battle form.

You revert to your original form to remain standing. You Dismiss your battle form and avoid being knocked out. You remain at 1 Hit Point, and your wounded condition increases by 1.

Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf (G.name: Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf (Greater)
Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf (G.description:
