You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (occult, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Dynamic Divine Lance.name: Dynamic Divine Lance
Dynamic Divine Lance.description:
You unleash a beam of divine energy. Make a ranged spell attack against the AC of a target within 30 feet.

1 On a hit, the creature is enveloped in a film of sanctified energy (holy if you are sanctified holy, or unholy if you are sanctified unholy). The next time within 1 minute that the creature takes spirit damage that does not already have the holy or unholy trait, that damage gains the trait corresponding to your divine lance. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.DnVO9aTKJOZFnNrg]{Effect: Divine Lance Tag}

2 On a hit, the target takes 2d4 spirit damage (double damage on a critical hit).

3 As the two-action version of the spell, except the spell’s range is 90 feet. Additionally, if you critically hit, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the two-action and three-action versions of the spell increases by 1d4.

Impulsive Magic.name: Impulsive Magic
Impulsive Magic.description: You are so in-tune with the powers associated with your wicket, you can respond to threats with it instinctively. You Cast a Spell with your wicket traits that takes 2 actions or less to cast and is at least 4 ranks below the maximum rank spell, and you must target the triggering creature with your spell or include them in the area of effect if it targets an area.

Howl of Winter (Greater).name: Howl of Winter (Greater)
Howl of Winter (Greater).description:
Activate 2 Interact, Strike

This spellgun somehow appears to be a naturally-formed pistol shaped icicle. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. This spellgun has a range increment of 30 feet. The spellgun blasts bone-chilling arctic wind that deals @Damage[12d6[cold]] damage, then melts.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 minute.

Success As critical success, except the target takes full damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty.

Voracious Drain.name: Voracious Drain
Voracious Drain.description:
You are no longer content to use only the blood that has already left a body. If your next action is to use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.JaoqIFWtitfe1jhr]{Sanguine Siphon}, the target makes a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.spellDC.value)] save against your spell DC. After making this save, the target is temporarily immune to your Voracious Drain for 1 minute.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} and you regain Hit Points equal to the amount of Hit Points the creature lost from the drained condition.

Magic Amulet (6th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (6th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (6th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 6th-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Effect: Terminus of Ultima.name: Effect: Terminus of Ultima
Effect: Terminus of Ultima.description: Cycle 1 Instead of returning your essence to 0 as normal for an essence cycle, your essence increases from 9 to 10. This means that starting the next turn, you can cast a 10th-rank spell. When you do, your essence is reduced to 0, but you don’t complete an additional essence cycle.

Bloodstained Bandana (Greater).name: Bloodstained Bandana (Greater)
Bloodstained Bandana (Greater).description:
This dark bandana is so stained and crusted with blood that it is no longer possible to tell what color or pattern it may have once had. Wearing this bandana heightens your sense of smell, but only for the scent of blood. You gain precise bloodsense with a range of 30 feet. Bloodsense allows you to detect living creatures that are taking persistent bleed damage or who have the dying or wounded condition. You also detect free-standing puddles or droplets of recently spilled blood. At the GM's discretion, living creatures without blood can't be detected with your bloodsense.

You ignore the flat check to target a creature taking persistent bleed damage, and reduce the flat check to target a hidden creature taking persistent bleed damage to 5.

Warped Reflection.name: Warped Reflection
Warped Reflection.description:
Trigger You would get a failure, but not a critical failure, on a Strike with your shadow weapon against a creature with a shadow.

You sift your shadow weapon through the netherworld itself, using a warped reflection of it to redirect your failed attack. Reroll the triggering Strike, using the new result for the attack roll. If the target has a shadow or is in an area of darkness, they are off-guard to your Strike.

Diadic Sacrifice.name: Diadic Sacrifice
Diadic Sacrifice.description:
Trigger Your mystic duo takes damage.

Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your connection has gotten so strong you can channel life force along its mystic lines. You transfer some of the damage through your mystic link, preventing it from harming your mystic duo and instead taking it yourself. You can negate up to half the damage dealt to your mystic duo and reduce your Hit Points by an equal amount. You cannot negate more Hit Points than you have remaining. Your mystic duo gains this reaction with its own frequency and the same limitations, with you as their mystic duo.

Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar (Major).name: Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar (Major)
Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (mental, occult) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (mental, occult) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Unhelpful Nudge.name: Unhelpful Nudge
Unhelpful Nudge.description:
Trigger A creature off-guard to you attempts to Stride

With but a thought and a wave of your hand, you cause an unprepared enemy to move. The target creature attempts a Reflex save. You push the creature 10 feet at any point during its Stride. If the creature would be pushed into another creature or object, it must attempt a Reflex save, falling @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} if it fails its save.

Culprit.name: Culprit
Culprit.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.v7zE3tKQb9G6PaYU]{Partner in Crime}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Deception or Thievery), another familiar ability as determined by your selection of skilled

Your familiar has a way with words and is easily able to communicate. Your familiar gains @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.cT5octWchU4gjrhP]{Manual Dexterity} if you choose skilled (Thievery) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech} if you choose skilled (Deception).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.VsqOHgyx52lQPRgV]{Advanced Culprit} When your familiar Aids you on a check, you can choose to forgo the circumstance bonus it grants to instead roll the check twice, once with your modifier and once with your familiar’s modifier to the triggering check, using the higher of the results as your result. This is a fortune effect.

Dynamic Guidance.name: Dynamic Guidance
Dynamic Guidance.description:
You ask for the guidance of supernatural entities.

1 You grant a target within 20 feet a +1 status bonus to one attack roll, Perception check, saving throw, or skill check the target attempts before the duration ends. The target chooses which roll to use the bonus on before rolling. If the target uses the bonus, the spell ends. Either way, the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

2 As the one-action version, except the spell affects up to 6 creatures within 30 feet.

3 As the one-action version, except the spell’s range is 30 feet and the target gains the status bonus on all checks of the listed types before the duration ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3qHKBDF7lrHw8jFK]{Spell Effect: Guidance}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.3LyOkV25p7wA181H]{Effect: Guidance Immunity}

Tethered Magic Spells.name: Tethered Magic Spells
Tethered Magic Spells.description:
You have learned magic normally unavailable to your magical tradition. Add all of the listed to your spell list. If you are a prepared caster, you immediately learn one of the listed spells from the spells below and if you are a spontaneous spellcaster you can immediately replace a spell in your spell repertoire to add one of the listed spells to your repertoire at an appropriate rank.

  • Ardor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.yafsV0ni7rFgqJBj]{Biting Words}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.b515AZlB0sridKSq]{Calm}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.jsWthW1Qy6tg3SwD]{Draw Ire}

  • Atmosphor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TSyFZNAbqfkRrcq0]{Concordant Choir}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.g8QqHpv2CWDwmIm1]{Gust of Wind}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.wzLkNU3AAqOSKFPR]{Noise Blast}

  • Desolator @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.8TQiFzGf4feoHeH0]{Chilling Spray}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.4GE2ZdODgIQtg51c]{Darkness}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.zdb8cjOIDVKYMWdr]{Penumbral Shroud}

  • Erosior @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.rnNGALRtsjspFTws]{Acidic Burst}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.mS3p6BR3LcG1WmHs]{Pave Ground}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.dgCH2E0gMLMUgyFl]{Shockwave}

  • Fabricator @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.UKsIOWmMx4hSpafl]{Dizzying Colors}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.iohRnd4gUCmJlh54]{Lose the Path}

  • Luminor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZxHC7V7HtjUsB8zH]{Blazing Bolt}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.y6rAdMK6EFlV6U0t]{Breathe Fire}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.v3vFzGazNSFEDdRB]{Radiant Field}

  • Magnetor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.2tHYKoVc5YhSewDO]{Leaden Steps}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.24U1b9K4Lj94cgaj]{Magnetic Repulsion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.zDJS8E66UI0himqV]{Thunderstrike}

  • Mortisor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.k34hDOfIIMAxNL4a]{Grim Tendrils}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.dxOF7d5kAWusLKWF]{Reaper's Lantern}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.XFtO4BBI22Uox2QP]{Sudden Blight}

Factotum.name: Factotum
Factotum.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.j9vOSbF9kLibhSIf]{Second Opinion}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.XCqYnlVbLGqEGPeX]{Touch Telepathy}

Your familiar is well-versed in a specific set of knowledge.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.jGx9fPmZD11nlDQt]{Advanced Factotum} Your familiar can use its second opinion for any check to Recall Knowledge, even if it does not have the skilled familiar ability in the skill you used for Recall Knowledge.

Expanded Mastery.name: Expanded Mastery
Expanded Mastery.description:
You’ve developed techniques for enhancing more of your spells. You gain dynamic mastery in 4 additional spells that are on your spell list.

Special If you are at least 8th level, you can take this feat a second time. When you do, you gain dynamic mastery in 6 additional spells.

Magic Chalice (6th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (6th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (6th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 6th-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Emergency Infusion.name: Emergency Infusion
Emergency Infusion.description: Minor blood sacrifices can stretch your magic beyond the limits. You take @Damage[(@actor.level/2)[persistent,bleed]] damage equal to half your level rounded up. You regain 1 Focus Point.

Omnidisciplinary Summoning.name: Omnidisciplinary Summoning
Omnidisciplinary Summoning.description: You reach across traditions to call upon the impossible. Select a summon spell from any spell tradition. You gain access to the spell as if it were a spell of your tradition.

Mortisor.name: Mortisor
Mortisor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of decay and death.

Wicket Traits death, void

Threaded Magic When a creature within the area of your wicket’s dominion below half Hit Points is targeted by one of your death or void spells, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}. This is an emotion, fear, and mental effect. The creature is then immune to this effect for 1 minute. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.48vlYdnIcd9RwCqW]

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the death trait on an undead, it is not automatically immune to the effect and is destroyed when it would normally die. When you Cast a Spell with the void trait that would target an undead creature, you can choose to deal spirit damage instead of void damage if the spell deals damage and the spell gains the spirit trait instead of the void trait if you do. You gain a +2 status bonus against mental effects for 1 round when you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the death trait
Access to at least one spell with the void trait

Horned Dragonbreath Longspear (Greater).name: Horned Dragonbreath Longspear (Greater)
Horned Dragonbreath Longspear (Greater).description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Refract Eidolon's Aspect.name: Refract Eidolon's Aspect
Refract Eidolon's Aspect.description:
Your eidolon's bond to you is, in effect, an exceptionally powerful aspect. By altering the magic that flows through it, you can transform it into multiple variants, like light passing through a prism. You unmanifest your eidolon, and summon three aspects in spaces adjacent to the space the eidolon held that remain under your control for 1 minute. These must be aspects you know and must share a trait with your eidolon. As these are all aspects of your eidolon, they all share its mind and you can communicate with them and cast spells on them as if they were your eidolon. Your summoned aspects use your actions just as your eidolon would, and you can use actions with the tandem trait with one of your aspects when you use the action as if it were your eidolon (such as Act Together). If one of these summoned aspects is reduced to 0 Hit Points, you take 20 mental damage as it is banished. If you Manifest Eidolon while your aspect summons are present, you immediately Dismiss all of your aspect summons as part of your activity.

Special If you have a Splintered Eidolon from Summoners+, all of the eidolons are unmanifested, and the refractions appear in or adjacent to any of their spaces.

Careless Swings.name: Careless Swings
Careless Swings.description:
You use a carefully-timed illusion to cause your foe to leave a small opening in their defenses for your allies to take advantage of. Choose either the manipulate or move trait.

Success The target is unaffected.

Failure The first time the target Strikes before the end of its next turn, it gains the chosen trait.

Critical Failure As failure, except all of the target’s Strikes gain the chosen trait until the end of its next turn.

Dynamic Translocate.name: Dynamic Translocate
Dynamic Translocate.description:
You instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container—the spell is lost.

1 The spell’s range is 30 feet.

2 The spell’s range is 100 feet.

3 You can cast this spell on an adjacent willing creature instead of yourself, moving that creature 120 feet.

Heightened (5th) The range for the 2-action version increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Heightened (8th) The range for the 3-action version increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see its destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. The willing creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Overwhelming.name: Overwhelming
Overwhelming.description: Magic that comes from overwhelming rings explode out with unnatural force on random occasions. Spell attacks you modify with Veracious Spell are a critical success on a 19 on the die as long as that result is a success. This property has no effect on a 19 if the result would be a failure.

Draining Cast.name: Draining Cast
Draining Cast.description: You replace the magical energy of a spell with your own lifeblood. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, you don’t expend the triggering spell slot, but instead reduce your Hit Points by twice the rank of the spell. This is not damage and thus cannot be reduced, resisted, or otherwise mitigated in any way, otherwise the spell fails.

Magnetor.name: Magnetor
Magnetor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of magnetism and electric currents.

Wicket Traits electricity, metal

Threaded Magic Choose 2 creatures within the area of your wicket’s dominion. Both creatures must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save against your spell DC. Creatures that fail their save are pushed 10 feet towards the other creature you selected. A creature can choose to get a failure on their save against this effect. This is forced movement.

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the electricity trait that deals damage, you can choose to deal slashing damage instead of electricity damage. When you Cast a Spell with the metal trait that would target a single creature, the creature gains a weakness to electricity damage after you Cast the Spell equal to its rank until the beginning of their next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Zgv994vvXgTO4wp3]

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the electricity trait
Access to at least one spell with the metal trait

Magic Tome (4th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (4th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (4th-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Effect: Terminus of Power.name: Effect: Terminus of Power
Effect: Terminus of Power.description:
Cycle 1 You gain a +1 circumstance bonus per rank to spell damage with spells that increase your essence or a +2 circumstance bonus per rank if the spell is an essence spell. This applies only to the initial damage the spell deals when cast. An individual creature takes this damage only once per spell, even if the spell would damage that creature multiple times.

Non-damaging spells deal an amount of physical damage of a type of your choice (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) to affected enemies equal to the circumstance bonus; if the spell has a spell attack roll, this damage is full on a success or double on a critical success, with no damage on a miss. If the spell has a saving throw, this damage is affected by the result as it would be by a basic save.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonus to damage for essence spells increases to +3.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonus to spells that increase your essence becomes +2 and the circumstance bonus to essence spells increases to +4.

Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear (Majo.name: Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear (Major)
Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear (Majo.description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Effect: Terminus of Soul.name: Effect: Terminus of Soul
Effect: Terminus of Soul.description:
Cycle 1 You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to savings throws until the end of the encounter. After you Cast a Spell that would increase essence, you can attempt another saving throw against an ongoing spell, effect, or condition that initially affected you during this encounter and that allowed a saving throw, using the result of the new saving throw instead if it’s better. If you do, you end your terminus effect and the next time you use Terminus of Soul you are at cycle 1.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonus increases to +3, and if you choose to end the effect early and roll a success on the new saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonus increases to +4, and if you choose to end the effect early, you treat the result of your new saving throw as one degree of success better than the one you rolled.

Magic Chalice (1st-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (1st-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (1st-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 1st-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Twist Vector.name: Twist Vector
Twist Vector.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon.

Your shadow weapon warps the fabric of reality to target another defense. Make a Strike with your shadow weapon, but you can choose to target their Reflex DC or Will DC instead of their AC for your attack roll. Your shadow weapon then immediately dissipates and you must Interact to draw your shadow weapon again.

Darkened Forest Shift.name: Darkened Forest Shift
Darkened Forest Shift.description:
Your apparition casts a feral shadow over your form. You can polymorph into any form listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.TXZWyxFYuhQeQ5ue]{Pest Shift} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.gEkEhXzPL5ZBdSKU]{(Spell Effect: Pest Shift)}. When you transform into a form granted by a spell, you gain all the effects of the form you chose from a version of the spell heightened to darkened forest form's rank. Each time you Sustain this Spell, you can choose to change to a different shape from those available via any of the associated spells.

Heightened (2nd) You can also transform into the forms listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.lV8etIlOczlCbJ46]{Animal Shift} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.TLIkcaSk5Zx3iFjK]{(Spell Effect: Animal Shift)}.

Heightened (5th) You can also transform into the forms listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.bK4rp20XuJRWGsEv]{Elemental Shift} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.ARrJ3NLQQRzneYjc]{(Spell Effect: Elemental Shift)}.

Dynamic Gouging Claw.name: Dynamic Gouging Claw
Dynamic Gouging Claw.description:
You temporarily morph your limb into a clawed appendage.

1 You gain a claw Strike for 1 minute. The claw deals 1d6 slashing damage, has the agile and finesse traits, and is in the knife weapon group. You gain the critical specialization effect of the claw. You become temporarily immune to gaining a claw Strike from this spell for 10 minutes. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.aOmuJ22sbAVA8w1T]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Gouging Claw}

2 Your morph is powerful but fleeting. Make a melee spell attack roll against a target's AC within your melee reach. If you hit, you deal your choice of 2d6 slashing damage or 2d6 piercing damage plus @Damage[@item.rank[persistent,bleed]]{1 persistent bleed} damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage (but not double bleed damage).

3 You gain a claw Strike as described in the one-action version. Until the end of your next turn, the claw Strike’s reach increases by 10 feet. Make a melee spell attack roll against the AC of a target within your reach. Your reach is extended by 20 feet instead of 10 feet for this attack. If you hit, you deal your choice of 2d6 slashing damage or 2d6 piercing damage, plus 2 persistent bleed damage. On a critical success, you deal double damage and double bleed damage. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.aOmuJ22sbAVA8w1T]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Gouging Claw}

Heightened (+1) The damage of the spell attack increases by 1d6 and the persistent bleed damage for the 2 and 3 action versions of the spell increases by 1.

Cross-Discipline Studies.name: Cross-Discipline Studies
Cross-Discipline Studies.description:
The sister traditions of haemothurgy and sanguimancy are similar enough that many who study one tradition also study the other, and there are tricks that can only be learned by those who know both. You gain a benefit based on which prerequisite dedication feat you have. If you have both prerequisite feats, you gain the Haemothurge Dedication benefit.

Haemothurge Dedication You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.HASFgAZ7spYleeaq]{Sanguimancer Dedication} as a bonus feat. If you already had Sanguimancer Dedication, you can immediately retrain it.

Sanguimancer Dedication You gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.JaoqIFWtitfe1jhr]{Sanguine Siphon}. Once you use Sanguine Siphon, you can’t use it again for 1d4 rounds. In addition, when you use Sanguine Siphon, instead of regaining Hit Points, you can choose to gain sanguimancy Hit Points equal to half your level that last until the end of your next turn.

Special You can take this feat multiple times, each time gaining one benefit you don’t already have.

Transitory Magic Junction.name: Transitory Magic Junction
Transitory Magic Junction.description:
You are never without the ability to access certain magic. You gain the listed effect based on the type of casting.

Prepared Spellcaster You can spend 10 minutes to empty one of your prepared spell slots that has a trait associated with your wicket and prepare a different spell you know that has a trait associated with your wicket. If you are interrupted during such a swap, the original spell remains prepared and can still be cast. You can try again to swap out the spell later, but you must start the process over again.

Spontaneous Spellcaster During your daily preparations, choose a spell with a trait associated with your wicket in your spell repertoire. That spell is a signature spell for you until your next daily preparations.

Special If you are a wizard with the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.QzWXMCSGNfvvpYgF]{Spell Substitution} thesis, you can swap two spells in the time it would take you to swap one as long as one of the spells has a trait associated with your wicket.

Tools of Darkness.name: Tools of Darkness
Tools of Darkness.description: You can wield shadow tools when the time serves you. You learn the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.wLBCTxPo3Go5g5JF]{Tools of Darkness} focus spell.

Terminus of Renewal.name: Terminus of Renewal
Terminus of Renewal.description:
Trigger You complete a essence cycle.

Requirements Your essence draw and essence pool are currently reduced due to incantations.

Cycle 1 You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} any number of active incantations. Then, you regain any reduced essence draw and essence pool from incantations that have ended or that had no duration.

Scepter of Second Chances.name: Scepter of Second Chances
Scepter of Second Chances.description:
The birch these scepters shed its paper like bark as if it were still a living tree. The bark disappears quickly, leading some wielders to write secret desires on them and watch them vanish, in hopes that they will come back in reality.

Activate—Dangerous Odds 1 (manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per hour

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would target a single creature and requires a Will save, you can use your reaction if the target rolls a success on their save to force the creature to reroll their save and take the new result. This is a misfortune effect.

Activate—Manifest Desires 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day;

Cost a spell slot of at least 5th rank

You and allies within 30 feet can manifest a better reality for yourselves for a number of rounds equal to the rank of the spell you expended. For the duration, affected creatures can choose to reroll a single attack roll, saving throw, or skill check. They must take the new result even if it is worse. This is a fortune effect.

Mirage Dragonbreath Bec de Corbin.name: Mirage Dragonbreath Bec de Corbin
Mirage Dragonbreath Bec de Corbin.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar (Maj.name: Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar (Major)
Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar (Maj.description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Monstrosity Shape+.name: Monstrosity Shape+
Monstrosity Shape+.description:
You can transform into a powerful magical creature. Add the cave worm and sea serpent shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8AMvNVOUEtxBCDvJ]{Monstrosity Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list.

If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift}, add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.dhkn1t8nbHrlqQ99]{Thurse Shift} aspects to untamed aspect shift list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.wNHUryoRzlfDCFAd]{Soaring Shape}, also add the phoenix shape to your untamed form list.

Scepter of Purifying.name: Scepter of Purifying
Scepter of Purifying.description:
You can tell this scepter by its effervescent smelling handle.

Activate—Purifying Spell 1 (manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per hour

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would restore Hit Points to a single creature, you can attempt to counteract the target’s sickened condition in addition to the normal effects using the rank of the spell you cast for your counteract modifier.

Activate—Purifying Wave 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day;

Cost a spell slot of at least 4th rank

You restore @Damage[1d8[healing]] Hit Points per rank of the spell to all creatures within a @Template[type:cone|distance:30]. You can attempt to counteract the sickened condition of all creatures in the area or a disease or poison affecting a single target in the area using the rank of the spell you expended as the spell rank for your counteract modifier.

Sticky Wicket.name: Sticky Wicket
Sticky Wicket.description:
Your dominion is wherever you step. When you cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.LHh2MWWJY4La9pDN]{Manifest Wicket Dominion}, you can choose to give the spell the aura trait, causing the emanation to remain around you for the duration. If your movement would cause a threaded magic effect to be outside the area of the spell, the threaded magic effect immediately ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.BE4ViueO8zTbehY7]{Spell Effect: Wicket Dominion Aura}

Sleuth.name: Sleuth
Sleuth.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.FlRUb8U13Crj3NaA]{Scent} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Society), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.fmsVItn94FeY5Q3X]{Snoop}

Your familiar is exceptional at locating information and others.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.c0iMtCfd5ypLwfGs]{Advanced Sleuth} When your familiar Aids you on a check, you can choose to forgo the circumstance bonus it grants to instead roll the check twice, once with your modifier and once with your familiar’s modifier to the triggering check, using the higher of the results as your result. This is a fortune effect.

Unified Perseverance.name: Unified Perseverance
Unified Perseverance.description:
Trigger You and your mystic duo would attempt a saving throw against the same magical effect.

Requirements Your mystic link is active.

The link you and your mystic duo share means you can help each other avoid danger with almost no effort. You each gain a +2 status bonus to your saving throw against the triggering effect. You use the higher of the results between the two of you for each of your results.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.1bGVcPaOSQgJKASr]{Effect: Unified Perseverance}

Archmage Dedication.name: Archmage Dedication
Archmage Dedication.description:
You are an archmage, a spellcaster whose mastery of magic transcends normal limitations. With a simple thought, you can stymie other spellcasters’ ability to cast spells without expending your own spells. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.oN0stoayFGzsfG3C]{Archmage’s Counter} reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.gr3jpClifIi93Bjx]{Archmage}

prerequisites.value: ability to cast spells from spell slots

Terminus of Life.name: Terminus of Life
Terminus of Life.description:
Trigger You complete a essence cycle.

The overflowing vital essence within you increases the healing of your future spells and provides succor when you cast other spells.

Cycle 1 You gain a +2 circumstance bonus per rank to healing with essence spells. This applies only to the initial healing the spell causes when cast. An individual creature benefits from this healing only once per spell, even if the spell would heal that creature multiple times.

In addition, if you Cast a Spell that would increase your essence and doesn’t heal a creature, you or one of the spell’s targets of your choice gains 2 temporary Hit Points per spell rank or 4 temporary Hit Points per spell rank for an essence spell. You can choose to grant the temporary Hit Points instead of additional healing when using a healing spell if you wish to conserve your life reservoir.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonus is +3, and the temporary Hit Points increases to 3 per spell rank or 6 per spell rank if it was an essence spell.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonus is +4, and the temporary Hit Points increases to 4 per spell rank or 8 per spell rank if it was an essence spell.

Creeping Cold.name: Creeping Cold
Creeping Cold.description:
You cause frost creep and numb a creature’s extremities. The target takes 1d6 persistent cold damage with a Fortitude save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half persistent damage and a –1 status penalty to their Reflex saves until the start of their next turn.

Failure The target takes the full persistent damage and a –1 status penalty to their Reflex saves as long as they are taking this persistent damage.

Critical Failure As failure, but the status penalty is –2.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.QEhUuvwX5nWeoWS9]{Spell Effect: Creeping Cold}

Heightened (+1) The persistent damage increases by 1d6.

Eldritch Wicketeer Dedication.name: Eldritch Wicketeer Dedication
Eldritch Wicketeer Dedication.description: Your dominion now uses tethered magic to produce powerful effects. When you Cast a Spell from Focus Points or spell slots with at least one of your wicket’s traits while within the area, you gain your wicket’s threaded magic effect. You apply this effect before or after resolving any effects of the spell, a choice you make when you Cast the Spell. You can Dismiss these effects and any tethered magic effect automatically ends if your wicket’s dominion is no longer in effect. You can only trigger a tethered magic effect once per round.

prerequisites.value: You must have the spellcasting class feature from your class

NPC Essence Spellcasting.name: NPC Essence Spellcasting
NPC Essence Spellcasting.description:
A barebones utility for Essence Spellcasting for NPCs in form of an Effect with a counter to track your Essence, and a choice of Terminus.

This does not automate Essence Spellcasting. Adjust your sheets manually.

Running Summon.name: Running Summon
Running Summon.description: You can keep your summon fighting even while you are on the move. You Stride and spend a single action to Sustain a summon spell.

Acolyte.name: Acolyte
Acolyte.description:
Prerequisites You must have the spellcasting class feature.

Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.rs4Awf4k1e0Mj797]{Cantrip Connection}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.wOgvBymJOVQDSm1Q]{Spell Delivery}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (your spellcasting tradition skill)

Your familiar is connected with your spellcasting innately.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.pKLhza4H14Qfnm5X]{Advanced Acolyte} Your familiar can move twice before it delivers the spell when it uses spell delivery.

Befuddling Spell.name: Befuddling Spell
Befuddling Spell.description:
Your expertise with spell modification allows you to craft variant spells that perplex all who see them. You can customize the appearance of your spells, as long as they remain roughly in keeping with the spell’s damage and effects. For example, your Casting of lightning bolt might look like summoning electric dragons, or your Casting of fireballs might look like opening a portal to Hell.

If the next action you spend is to Cast a Spell, all creatures take a –4 circumstance penalty to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.eReSHVEPCsdkSL4G]{Identify the Magic}, as well as a –2 circumstance penalty to Counteract the spell.

Essence Draw.name: Essence Draw
Essence Draw.description: Your essence draw represents the maximum amount of essence up to which you can safely draw when casting a draw cantrip. An essence spellcaster’s essence draw begins at 1 and increases to 2 at 7th level, and then again at 9th level and every 2 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 7 at 17th level.

Cycle Terminus.name: Cycle Terminus
Cycle Terminus.description:
At 3rd level, you gain your choice of one of the following terminus free actions, depending on your tradition.

Arcane spellcasters can choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.iHEG6M3sZEkJRedO]{Terminus of Insight} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.YM12oebWBuTVv28K]{Terminus of Power};

Divine spellcasters can choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.NO5aStnPMpwWfUKf]{Terminus of Life} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.mBuBMBAhneGY1NM7]{Terminus of Soul};

Occult spellcasters can choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.iHEG6M3sZEkJRedO]{Terminus of Insight} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.mBuBMBAhneGY1NM7]{Terminus of Soul};

And primal spellcasters can choose between @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.NO5aStnPMpwWfUKf]{Terminus of Life} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.YM12oebWBuTVv28K]{Terminus of Power}.

You can retrain your choice of terminus action with 1 day of downtime.

Magic Tome (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (2nd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Power of Blood.name: Power of Blood
Power of Blood.description:
While some mages rely on books, foci or gods, you carry the source of your magic within you. If you choose this class archetype, you must select Haemothurge Dedication as your 2nd-level class feat.

Prerequisites: You must be able to bleed, have the spellcasting class feature from your class.

Haemothurge Adjustments: Increase your maximum Hit Points by your level. When you Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you take persistent bleed damage equal to the rank of the spell. This persistent bleed damage bypasses any resistances or immunities. In addition, the DC of the flat check to end persistent bleed damage for you is reduced from 15 to 12, from 15 to 10 if you are at least 9th level, from 15 to 8 if you are at least 13th level, or from 15 to 5 if you are at least 17th level (or 5 less than these numbers if you have particularly effective assistance to a minimum of an automatic success at 17th level). You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.fZntOuJKiFAVWB3h]{Bleeding Spell} spellshape.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.5HLm2qhSCzUr090m]{Haemothurge and Bloodmagic Feats}

Dynamic Haste.name: Dynamic Haste
Dynamic Haste.description:
Magic empowers the target to act faster. It gains the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} condition and can use the extra action each round for only Strike and Stride actions.

1 The spell’s range is touch and it lasts until the end of your next turn.

2 The spell’s range is 20 feet and it lasts for 1 minute.

3 The spell’s range is 60 feet and it lasts for 1 minute.

Heightened (7th) You can target up to 6 creatures.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.Item.ElkXovNrHB0Doi6O]{Spell Effect: Haste}

Propulsor.name: Propulsor
Propulsor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of propulsion and turbulence.

Wicket Traits force, water

Threaded Magic When you successfully make a spell attack roll or a creature fails its save against a spell with the water trait, you push the target 5 feet in a direction of your choice (or 10 feet if your spell attack roll was a critical success or the creature’s save was a critical failure). This is forced movement. When you cast a force spell, you can remove the prone condition from a creature within the area of your wicket’s dominion, as if they had used the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.OdIUybJ3ddfL7wzj]{Stand} action. This Stand action does not provoke reactions.

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the water trait that deals bludgeoning damage, you can choose to deal force damage instead of bludgeoning damage. When you damage a creature with a force spell that does not require a saving throw, they must attempt a @Check[type:fortitude|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save against your spell DC. Creatures that fail their save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of their next turn, or are knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} on a critical failure.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the force trait
Access to at least one spell with the water trait

Magic Chalice (9th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (9th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (9th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 9th-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Power Ring (Iron).name: Power Ring (Iron)
Power Ring (Iron).description:
This seemingly simple metal band glows with mystic heat when magic travels through your fingers. You can add special ring runes to a power ring to further heighten your mastery over magic. When activated, it imbues your attack spells with increased accuracy. During your daily preparations, choose a single cantrip you can cast that would require a spell attack roll. The cantrip you chose can ignore the frequency of the ring’s activation. You can imbue one ring rune into the ring.

Activate—Veracious Spell f (flourish, manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

The ring’s magic guides your attack. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would require a spell attack roll, you gain a +1 item bonus to your spell attack roll. If the spell has multiple targets, the bonus applies to all of them. If a spell you modified with this effect could make additional spell attack rolls on a Sustain, the item bonus applies to these spell attack rolls as well.

Plant Shape+.name: Plant Shape+
Plant Shape+.description:
You can take the shape of a plant creature. If you don't have untamed form, you can cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.qH18jW3EMywavprR]{Plant Shift} once per day, heightened to the same rank as your highest-rank druid spell slot.

If you do have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form}, add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.qH18jW3EMywavprR]{Plant Shift} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift} list, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.zCcfPS4y5SrZzU2x]{Plant Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list, and whenever you're polymorphed into another shape using either of those spells, you gain resistance 5 to poison.

Rowdy.name: Rowdy
Rowdy.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.mK3mAUWiRLZZYNdz]{Damage Avoidance} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.FcQQLMAJMgOLjnSv]{Resistance}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Athletics), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Le8UWr5BU8rV3iBf]{Tough}

Your familiar is tough and formidable for its size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.fgQQr4wpjaYnVKFz]{Advanced Rowdy} Your familiar is treated as one size category larger for the purposes of creatures it could use Athletics checks against, allowing them to use Athletics maneuvers against creatures of appropriate size. You can select this ability more than once, each time increasing the effective size of the creature by one size category for the purposes of Athletics maneuvers.

Companion Aspect.name: Companion Aspect
Companion Aspect.description: You send supernatural power into a companion. If your next action is to cast a summon spell, you can target a minion in range instead. The summon emerges in your companion’s space, and has your companion’s senses, special abilities, and actions in addition to its normal senses, special abilities, and actions, gaining actions when you Sustain the spell as normal. If the spell ends or is dismissed, your companion returns to the space the summon last occupied. If the summon is banished or destroyed, your companion returns to the space the summon last occupied at 0 Hit Points with the unconscious condition.

Incantations.name: Incantations
Incantations.description:
Incantations are longer versions of spells that can’t be used during an encounter. If the spell would normally be a reaction, an incantation is also a reaction. For other spells, an incantation takes either 20 seconds or the spell’s normal casting time, whichever is longer—if your timing is tight enough that you don’t have 20 seconds to spare and you’re keeping track of things round by round, chances are good that you should already be in an encounter. At the end of the incantation, you cast an essence spell with a rank up to your current essence pool without needing essence to do so. However, this comes at a cost: an incantation reduces both your essence draw and your essence pool by 1, and if that would reduce your essence draw to 0, you can’t draw essence or cast essence spells. You don’t recover your essence draw and essence pool automatically from an incantation, but enough time to focus can restore your essence pathways. When you Refocus, you can choose to Dismiss any incantations you have active. Then, you regain any reduced essence draw and essence pool from the incantations that have ended or had no duration to begin with.

A long incantation takes 1 hour or the spell’s normal casting time to cast, whichever is longer. A long incantation comes with none of the same drawbacks as a normal incantation, but its effects end if you use an incantation again.

If an incantation creates a permanent object, even if it doesn’t have a duration, the object disappears after casting a long incantation or recovering your essence draw and essence pool from the incantation.

If you substitute a spell into your prepared spells or repertoire (such as with the wizard spell substitution thesis), you can’t use it for an incantation for 1 hour.

Drain Destiny.name: Drain Destiny
Drain Destiny.description: You charge your spells with malevolent energy capable of stealing your enemy’s very destiny. If the next action you use is to make a Spellstrike or Cast a Spell that targets a single opponent and requires an attack roll, that spell can siphon away mythic power from the target. If the spell attack roll is a success, you regain a Mythic Point; if the target of the spell has any Mythic Points, they lose one.

Dismiss Paltry Magic.name: Dismiss Paltry Magic
Dismiss Paltry Magic.description: The power of the archmage allows you to dispell the weaker magics of others. Choose a creature within 30 feet. You attempt to counteract a single spell of your choice active on the target. Your counteract rank is equal to the highest rank spell you can cast, and your counteract check modifier is your spell attack roll modifier.

Thin the Blood.name: Thin the Blood
Thin the Blood.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet takes persistent bleed damage.

Some people have frustratingly thick blood that sticks stubbornly inside their veins. You’ve learned a couple tricks to get that blood flowing, which you can use on normal people to thin their blood dangerously. The flat check to remove the triggering persistent bleed damage increases by 5 until the end of your next turn, usually to DC 20, or DC 15 with especially effective assistance.

Summon Fey Aspect.name: Summon Fey Aspect
Summon Fey Aspect.description:
You call upon a fey creature to do your bidding. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.uhw3SFYeTt13E6K2]{fey aspect} that can be up to Small in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.Actor.oD13HAUTQ6UIDdtZ] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.TUDKBMHIcyoCLs5x]{Spell Effect: Fey Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.Macro.QBuwWXb7rBcpexLn]{Summon Fey Aspect}

Dynamic Spellsage Dedication.name: Dynamic Spellsage Dedication
Dynamic Spellsage Dedication.description:
You’ve taken your first steps on the path of dynamic magic. You gain access to the uncommon dynamic spells in the Magic+ book. Additionally, you’ve learned to pull greater power out of several of your dynamic spells. You gain dynamic mastery in 3 spells that are on your spell list.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.7sUDpfyvfnRsB5Yi]{Dynamic Spell Sage}

prerequisites.value: You can Cast spells using spell slots

Assistant.name: Assistant
Assistant.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.cT5octWchU4gjrhP]{Manual Dexterity}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (one skill that requires tools), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.uUrsZ4WvhjKjFjnt]{Toolbearer}

Your familiar is effective with tools and assisting you with your efforts.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.xiDjduyosXBVMhOv]{Advanced Assistant} Your familiar can wield tools up to 1 Bulk instead of up to L bulk. Your familiar can use actions that would require being trained proficiency for its selection of skilled.

Magic Tome (7th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (7th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (7th-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Basic Essence Spellcasting.name: Basic Essence Spellcasting
Basic Essence Spellcasting.description:
Instead of the normal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#basic-spellcasting-feat]{Basic Spellcasting Feat}, when using essence casting, the basic spellcasting benefits are as follows: You gain a 1st-rank spell slot, and an essence draw and maximum essence pool of 1 if you didn’t have one. If you have a spell repertoire, you can select one spell from your repertoire as a signature spell. At 8th level, they grant you a 2nd-rank spell slot and increase your maximum essence pool to 2 if it was lower. You also gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GMpbfdVHBUaiIwSy]{Essence Conduit} at 8th level.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.gWcA65AL89Y9Bcxr]{Essence Spellcasting Archetypes}

Instant Manifestation.name: Instant Manifestation
Instant Manifestation.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Your dominion comes to you immediately when in danger arises. You Cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.LHh2MWWJY4La9pDN]{Manifest Wicket Dominion}.

Fey Shift.name: Fey Shift
Fey Shift.description:
You transform into a fey creature of the First World. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.uhw3SFYeTt13E6K2]{fey aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.TUDKBMHIcyoCLs5x]{Spell Effect: Fey Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Morph Self.name: Morph Self
Morph Self.description:
Requirements You are in a battle form.

You alter the fabric of your battle form and reshape yourself. You Dismiss your current battle form and immediately Cast a Spell that would grant you a battle form.

Linked Target Spell.name: Linked Target Spell
Linked Target Spell.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your connection allows magic to flow through each of you. If your next action you use is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 1 rank lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have and targets yourself (such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TVKNbcgTee19PXZR]{Shield}), you can instead grant the effects to your mystic duo. Your mystic duo must be willing to accept the effect. If the spell you cast has a duration, it immediately ends if your mystic link ends. You are still the caster of the spell and must take any actions that would be required for the spell instead of your mystic duo (such as the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.3f5DMFu8fPiqHpRg]{Sustain} action or the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction for shield). If you use Linked Target Spell again while a spell with its effects is still active, you immediately end the previous effect.

Tenacious Magic.name: Tenacious Magic
Tenacious Magic.description: You pull additional magical energy into yourself and ready it to supercharge your next spell with tenacious potency. Once per day, you can use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.ejOTX1ukDVNorpt2]{Mythic Casting} without expending a Mythic Point.

Aspect Sage.name: Aspect Sage
Aspect Sage.description: You can peer beyond the confines of magic to call upon any of your summons. If your next action is to cast an aspect summon spell, you can choose a single common aspect ability to grant your aspect summon that it would not normally have of your choice. It gains that aspect ability for the duration of the spell.

prerequisites.value: You know at least one summon aspect spell
Aspect Caller Dedication or you're a Summoner

Fountain of Blood.name: Fountain of Blood
Fountain of Blood.description:
Trigger A creature takes bleed damage.

You cause the triggering creature’s blood to geyser out in a horrific display of ultraviolence. Each other creature within 15 feet of the triggering creature must make a Will save. The target is then temporarily immune for 10 minutes.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Shade of Night.name: Shade of Night
Shade of Night.description:
Plunging creatures into darkness to conceal yourself and your allies or to confuse your enemies. The target creature attempts a Fortitude save, reducing their ability to see in darkness or low-light. Depending on their save, the target reduces their darkvision to low-light vision, and low-light vision to no special vision. If the creature has light sensitivity, it is suppressed for the duration. If the target is a willing ally, the ally can choose which result it gets without rolling.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target’s vision is reduced for 1 round.

Failure The target’s vision is reduced for 1 minute.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is also blinded for 1 round.

Heightened (2nd) The spell reduces a creature's darkvision and low-light vision to no special vision.

Heightened (4th) The spell reduces greater darkvision to low-light vision in addition to its other effects.

Desolator.name: Desolator
Desolator.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of frigidness and darkness.

Wicket Traits cold, darkness

Threaded Magic When you Cast a Spell with the cold trait that targets a creature or area, you reduce the light level in the area by one step, from bright light to dim light and from dim light to darkness, until the end of your next turn. The area of the effect is the same area as the spell or a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] that includes the target if it targeted a creature. Creatures in areas of darkness gain a weakness to cold damage equal to half your level. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.fA7lqi21ozmcX573]

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the cold trait that deals damage, you can choose to deal spirit damage instead of cold damage. Creatures in areas of darkness within your wicket’s dominion gain a weakness to spirit damage equal to half your level.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the cold trait
Access to at least one spell with the darkness trait

Summon Construct Aspect.name: Summon Construct Aspect
Summon Construct Aspect.description:
You assemble a construct to your side. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.VNtyYlVBQoNGAthk]{construct aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.fbm9MHSnilOoGve6]{Construct Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.vzxNTBV15l6LVfYM]{Spell Effect: Entity Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.j1aJm4O4s2wior3W]{Summon Construct Aspect}

Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance (Greater).name: Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance (Greater)
Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance (Greater).description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Magic Chalice (7th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (7th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (7th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 7th-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Pest Shift.name: Pest Shift
Pest Shift.description:
You transform into a critter or vermin unlikely to attract attention, like a rat, cat or insect. You become a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.XbPY6LojeQrqUfjI]{pest aspect}. While in this form, you can't make Strikes.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.gEkEhXzPL5ZBdSKU]{Spell Effect: Pest Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Through the Wicket.name: Through the Wicket
Through the Wicket.description:
While other spellcasters are limited to the spells of their tradition, through funneling magical power through certain gates you increase its strength but narrow your masteries. If you choose this class archetype, you must select @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.NjgmPMpyb6Y1nebZ]{Eldritch Wicketeer Dedication} as your 2nd-level class feat.

Eldritch Wicketeer Adjustments: Choose a wicket, a culmination of magic based on specific magical traits. You can only select a wicket if your tradition has at least one spell that is cast from spell slots with each of your wicket’s traits. Reduce your number of spell slots of each spell level by 1. Reduce the number of cantrips you gain from your class by 1. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.LHh2MWWJY4La9pDN]{Manifest Wicket Dominion} focus spell.

At 11th level, you gain the Overwhelming Wicket ability while within the area of your wicket’s dominion.

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.BpnxSJD1rCDolxQU]{Ardor} (auditory, emotion)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.kj1SZfPCqVOkBbec]{Atmosphor} (air, sonic)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.aANtNYkjWu5xtycR]{Erosior} (acid, earth)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.RmlKxZWHK4M0nSE5]{Extingor} (cold, darkness)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.Thlikh0Rk1lFJuUM]{Fabricator} (illusion, visual)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.lnYZdlWFNtXG5hKF]{Luminor} (fire, light)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.JYYo8ElGuzm99WP8]{Magnetor} (electricity, metal)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.J1cXlcK3NXpanDMB]{Mortisor} (death, void)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.OdyGd2d7I6AUpXrL]{Propulsor} (force, water)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.c7VshoY6Cr4CeB3N]{Savior} (healing, vitality)

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Item.ct1WvxqXIXBduk8e]{Verdor} (plant, wood)

prerequisites.value: You must have the spellcasting class feature from your class and are not a bounded caster.

Fabricator.name: Fabricator
Fabricator.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of fabrication and sensory synapses.

Wicket Traits illusion, visual

Threaded Magic When you create an illusion within your wicket’s dominion, choose a specific creature within the area of your wicket’s dominion. The creature takes a –2 circumstance bonus to disbelieve your illusion spells or a +2 status bonus to sight-based Perception checks while within the area. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.BXSnbI2cDxkCQY5h]{Effect: Fabricator's Precautions}

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the illusion trait, you can choose to deal half the damage type appropriate for the illusion to creatures that would normally take mental damage from your illusions. When you Cast a Spell with the visual trait on an immune creature, you translate the effect to another sense, bypassing its immunity to visual. The creature must have at least one other sense to bypass its immunity.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the illusion trait
Access to at least one spell with the visual trait

Umbral Sculptor Dedication.name: Umbral Sculptor Dedication
Umbral Sculptor Dedication.description:
Your ability to infuse shadow essence allows you to find shadow essences in your surroundings. You can no longer use abilities with the light trait; if an ability, such as a class feature or ancestry feat, would automatically grant you a light ability, such as the light spell, you don’t gain that ability. You gain low-light vision or darkvision if you already had low-light vision. If you have darkvision, you instead gain a +1 status bonus to Perception checks while in total darkness.

You can wield your shadow as a weapon. You can Interact to draw your shadow weapon just as you would a normal weapon and you can etch your shadow with weapon runes with the same cost and restrictions as etching runes onto weapons. When you draw your shadow weapon as a weapon, you choose a simple or martial melee weapon in which you are at least trained to be its form. Any property runes that can't apply to the weapon form are suppressed until the shadow takes a shape to which they can apply. You can Dismiss your shadow weapon at any time, returning its essence and requiring you to Interact to draw it again. Your shadow weapon automatically dissipates if a creature other than you attempts to hold it or after 1 round if you are not wielding it.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.wUnjDaQE7xplUb8Q]{Umbral Sculptor}

The Master’s Veil.name: The Master’s Veil
The Master’s Veil.description: Your connection to your wicket protects you from magic of a similar nature. You gain a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects with your wicket traits.

Dynamic Caustic Blast.name: Dynamic Caustic Blast
Dynamic Caustic Blast.description:
You fling a large glob of acid that immediately detonates.

1 Target a creature with Hardness within 20 feet to cover it with an acid that temporarily weakens its defenses. The creature must attempt a Fortitude save. On any result except a critical success, the next time that the creature’s Hardness applies before the end of your next turn, the creature’s Hardness is reduced. The Hardness is reduced by 1 on a success, 3 on a failure, or 6 on a critical failure.
