2 The glob of acid explodes in a 5-foot burst within 20 feet. Creatures in the area take 1d8 acid damage with a basic Reflex save; on a critical failure, the creature also takes @Damage[(floor((@item.rank + 1)/ 2))[persistent,acid]] damage.

3 As the two-action version, except the spell’s range is 60 feet, and all creatures that are within 10 feet of the burst (but not within it) take 2 splash damage.

Heightened (+2) For the one-action version of the spell, the Hardness reduction increases by 1 on a success, by 3 on a failure, and by 6 on a critical failure. For the two and three-action versions of the spell, the initial damage increases by 1d8, and the persistent damage increases by 1. The splash damage for the three-action version increases by 2.

Twinned Target Spell.name: Twinned Target Spell
Twinned Target Spell.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your mystic link lets you split the energy of your spells with your mystic duo, granting the effects to both of you. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that is at least 2 ranks below the highest rank you can cast and would affect only yourself, it instead affects both you and your mystic duo as long as your mystic link is active. Your mystic duo must be willing to accept the effect.

Dynamic Fireball.name: Dynamic Fireball
Dynamic Fireball.description:
A roaring blast of fire detonates at a spot you designate, dealing an amount of fire damage with a range and area based upon the number of actions you spend.

1 The spell deals 3d4 damage in a 5-foot burst at a range of 60 feet.

2 The spell deals 6d6 damage in a 15-foot burst at a range of 120 feet.

3 The spell deals 6d6 fire damage in a 30-foot burst at a range of 500 feet. Creatures that fail the saving throw also take @Damage[@item.rank[persistent,fire]] damage. If only a single creature is in the fireball’s area, it takes twice as much persistent damage.

Heightened (+1) The fire damage increases by 1d4 for the one-action version or 2d6 for the two and three-action versions. Creatures that fail their save against the three-action version take 1 additional persistent fire damage.

Scepter of Sickening.name: Scepter of Sickening
Scepter of Sickening.description:
These scepters are often green and brown, have an unpleasant, greasy feeling when touched or have a faint yet repulsive odor. Using the rod to enhance a spell adds a bit of disgusting magic to it, leaving targets of the magic feeling sick.

Activate—Sicken Spell 1 (manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per hour

If your next action is to Cast a Spell with a basic Fortitude save, creatures that fail their save are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The creature is affected whether or not the spell does damage.

Activate—Rotting Aura 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Cost a spell slot of at least 3rd rank

You exude a putrid aura in a @Template[distance:20|type:emanation]. The aura lasts a number of rounds equal to the rank of the expended spell. Creatures that end their turn within the area become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} or increase the value of their sickened condition by 1, to a maximum of sickened 4. Creatures in the area cannot reduce their sickened condition below 1.

Advanced Culprit.name: Advanced Culprit
Advanced Culprit.description: When your familiar Aids you on a check, you can choose to forgo the circumstance bonus it grants to instead roll the check twice, once with your modifier and once with your familiar’s modifier to the triggering check, using the higher of the results as your result. This is a fortune effect.

Crushing Stampede.name: Crushing Stampede
Crushing Stampede.description:
You briefly call forth a great stampede to batter your foes, with effects depending on the number of actions you spend. Affected creatures take bludgeoning damage and might be disoriented or knocked over based on the results of a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage and is off-guard for 1 round.

Critical Failure The creature takes double damage and is knocked prone.

1 The stampede affects a single creature and deals 5d6 bludgeoning damage.

2 The stampede affects all creatures in a 30-foot burst and deals 10d6 bludgeoning damage.

3 You conjure a stampeding creature under each of your allies, allowing them to move to safety if they can manage to ride the perilous wave. As the 2-action version except allies in the area that succeed at their save against the spell take no damage and move to the edge of the spell’s radius in a direction of their choice. Allies that fail the saving throw experience the spell’s normal effects.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage of the 1-action version by 1d6 and the two-action and three-action versions by 2d6.

Dynamic Fly.name: Dynamic Fly
Dynamic Fly.description:
Your target soars through the air, gaining a fly Speed equal to its Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater.

1 You can only target yourself. As a part of the Casting the Spell, you Fly. The spell lasts until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.JMuyMnqdpAP1VNwe]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Flight}

2 The spell’s range is touch and its duration is 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.3h7yRA7nhtDdIs7s]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Fly}

3 You cast the spell on yourself and up to 6 other creatures within 60 feet, granting all targets a fly Speed. As a part of Casting the Spell, you Fly up to twice; the other targets do not. The spell lasts until the end of your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.JMuyMnqdpAP1VNwe]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Flight}

Heightened (7th) The one-action version and three action versions also grant all targets a +20-foot status bonus to their fly Speed until the end of your next turn. The duration of the two-action version increases to 30 minutes.

Magic Chalice (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (3rd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (3rd-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 3rd-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Unstable Aura.name: Unstable Aura
Unstable Aura.description: When you perform an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.nWrMVX6rsQanqjlj]{Unstable Draw}, the unstable essence surrounding you helps divert ranged attacks. Until you use the unstable essence to cast an essence spell, all ranged attacks against you must succeed at a @Check[dc:5|type:flat], or they miss, diverted in the wrong direction by the unstable energy.

Multidisciplinary Summoning.name: Multidisciplinary Summoning
Multidisciplinary Summoning.description:
Your aspects are not constrained to one tradition of magic, reaching into nearby essences to expand your magic. Select a tradition from the list below, determined by your spellcasting tradition. You gain access to a single summon spell from that tradition’s spell list as if it were a spell of your tradition.

Arcane, Divine occult or primal

Occult, Primal arcane or divine

Special You can select this feat a second time, gaining the tradition you did not pick the first time.

Phoenix Tail Feather.name: Phoenix Tail Feather
Phoenix Tail Feather.description: This large feather shimmers between orange and blue and is noticeably warm to the touch. Adding this catalyst to a casting of @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.KEkPxx7Sm6Xf4W3s]{Blazing Dive} prevents allies from having to save against the damage caused by your landing, instead being granted 2 temporary Hit Points per rank that last until the end of your next turn.

Warping.name: Warping
Warping.description: Spells cast through a ring with this rune can arc and change at sharp angles, allowing you to avoid allies and hit enemies around corners. When you Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll spell, you can select a single square within 15 feet to be the new point of origin for the spell. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from there, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The target of the spell must still be within range of the chosen square.

Verdant Bola.name: Verdant Bola
Verdant Bola.description:
Activate 2 Interact, Strike

This spellgun seems to be a slingshot full of large nuts at the ends of tangles of vines, rather than some kind of firearm. Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's Reflex DC. This spellgun has a range increment of 20 feet.

Critical Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained} until the end of your next turn or it Escapes using your spell DC for the DC to Escape.

Success As critical success, except the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} instead of restrained.

Magic Tome (9th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (9th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (9th-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Terminus of Power.name: Terminus of Power
Terminus of Power.description:
Trigger You complete a essence cycle.

The overflowing physical essence within you increases the power of your future spells.

Cycle 1 You gain a +1 circumstance bonus per rank to spell damage with spells that increase your essence or a +2 circumstance bonus per rank if the spell is an essence spell. This applies only to the initial damage the spell deals when cast. An individual creature takes this damage only once per spell, even if the spell would damage that creature multiple times.

Non-damaging spells deal an amount of physical damage of a type of your choice (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) to affected enemies equal to the circumstance bonus; if the spell has a spell attack roll, this damage is full on a success or double on a critical success, with no damage on a miss. If the spell has a saving throw, this damage is affected by the result as it would be by a basic save.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonus to damage for essence spells increases to +3.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonus to spells that increase your essence becomes +2 and the circumstance bonus to essence spells increases to +4.

Reactive Blood.name: Reactive Blood
Reactive Blood.description: As fear grows, heartbeats pulse quickly and the flow of blood quickens. You must be quick in order to take advantage of it. Choose a reaction you gained from this archetype. At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to use for the reaction you chose.

prerequisites.value: at least one haemothurge feat that grants a reaction

Construct Shift.name: Construct Shift
Construct Shift.description:
You transform into a golem or animated statue. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.VNtyYlVBQoNGAthk]{construct aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.vzxNTBV15l6LVfYM]{Spell Effect: Construct Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Energy.name: Energy
Energy.description:
Energy spells cause this ring to send a shimmering power through your hand.

Activate—Gather Power 1

Requirements Your last action was to Cast a Spell that dealt energy damage and was shaped by Veracious Spell;

You absorb some of the energy you are about to expel into your power ring. You hold a charge of Gathered Power in the ring of that energy type. These charges last for 1 minute or until expelled by using Release Power.

Activate—Release Power 1 (attack)

Requirements You have a charge of Gathered Power in the ring;

You shoot a ray of power from stored up energy in the ring. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC, dealing @Damage[5d4] damage on a success or twice that amount on a critical success. You apply the ring’s item bonus to this spell attack roll. The damage is of the same damage type as the energy used to Gather Power and you expel the charge of energy from Gathered Power.

Essence Weaver Dedication.name: Essence Weaver Dedication
Essence Weaver Dedication.description:
You are an essence weaver, you spool essences into spells with ease. You can prepare two additional cantrips each day if you are a prepared essence spellcaster or you add two additional cantrips from your spell list to your repertoire if you are a spontaneous caster.

When you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.cYHvzy96aWk5n8yC]{Initial Draw} class feature, you can choose to permanently lose both of these cantrips to instead gain 1 spell slot (and repertoire spell if you are a spontaneous caster) of a rank equal to your essence draw value. Each time your essence draw value increases, you can choose to change this spell to another spell of a rank equal to your essence draw value.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.9ROAxfnbuYJdtn2S]{Essence Weaver Archetype}

prerequisites.value: You are an Essence Spellcaster (not a bounded essence spellcaster or a multiclass essence spellcaster)

Spirit Boundary.name: Spirit Boundary
Spirit Boundary.description:
You call forth a stationary shield of defensive spirits that blunt dangerous forces that cross its boundaries. The spirits do not impede sight, movement, or line of effect. When an effect that deals damage passes through the spirit shield, reduce the damage that the effect deals by the listed amount; the shield takes the same amount of damage that it reduced. If the crossing effect deals damage to multiple creatures, the shield only takes damage once. When the shield is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it is destroyed. The size of the shield, the amount of damage reduced, and the shield’s durability depend upon the number of actions used to cast the spell.

1 The shield has a @Template[type:burst|distance:10]{10-foot radius} and [[(1 + @item.level) * 4]] Hit Points. It reduces damage that crosses it by [[(1 + @item.level)]].

2 The shield has a @Template[type:burst|distance:20]{20-foot radius} and [[2 + (@item.level) * 12]] Hit Points. It reduces damage that crosses it by [[(1 + @item.level) * 2]].

3 You can select any radius between @Template[type:burst|distance:5]{5 feet} and @Template[type:burst|distance:30]{30 feet} for the shield. The shield has [[2 + (@item.level) * 12]] Hit Points and reduces damage that crosses it by [[(1 + @item.level) * 2]]. You can Dismiss this spell as a reaction triggered by a damaging effect passing through it.

Heightened (+1) For the one-action version, increase the damage reduced by 1 and the shield’s Hit Points by 4. For the two-action version and three-action versions, increase the damage reduced by 2 and the shield’s Hit Points by 12.

Scourging.name: Scourging
Scourging.description: Spells cast with a scouring ring leave lasting wounds on the target. Each rune specializes in either acid, electricity, fire, or physical damage and the ring gains the trait of the damage type or force if the damage type is physical. When you critically succeed at a spell attack roll with a spell that has no duration and deals the damage type of the rune, the target also takes @Damage[1d10[@item.flags.pf2e.rulesSelections.scourging.damageType, persistent]] persistent damage of the same type the spell would deal or bleed damage if the spell dealt physical damage. If the spell would already deal persistent damage, the DC to end the persistent damage increases by 2.

Void Weapon.name: Void Weapon
Void Weapon.description: Your shadow now harbors even darker energies, allowing you to wield the void. Your shadow weapon gains the versatile trait for void damage.

Effect: Terminus of Life.name: Effect: Terminus of Life
Effect: Terminus of Life.description:
Cycle 1 You gain a +2 circumstance bonus per rank to healing with essence spells. This applies only to the initial healing the spell causes when cast. An individual creature benefits from this healing only once per spell, even if the spell would heal that creature multiple times.

In addition, if you Cast a Spell that would increase your essence and doesn’t heal a creature, you or one of the spell’s targets of your choice gains 2 temporary Hit Points per spell rank or 4 temporary Hit Points per spell rank for an essence spell. You can choose to grant the temporary Hit Points instead of additional healing when using a healing spell if you wish to conserve your life reservoir.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.iMDOgGa3KbVm7oOh]{Effect: Terminus of Life Temp HP}

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonus is +3, and the temporary Hit Points increases to 3 per spell rank or 6 per spell rank if it was an essence spell.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonus is +4, and the temporary Hit Points increases to 4 per spell rank or 8 per spell rank if it was an essence spell.

Erosior.name: Erosior
Erosior.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of chemical and mineral manipulation.

Wicket Traits acid, earth

Threaded Magic When you successfully make a spell attack roll or a creature fails its save against a spell with the earth trait, you create difficult terrain in squares adjacent to the target. When you successfully make a spell attack roll or a creature fails its save against a spell with the acid trait, you create hazardous terrain in all squares adjacent to the target. The hazardous terrain deals @Damage[@item.rank[acid]]{acid damage equal to the rank of the spell} that created it each time a creature passes through the area. The difficult terrain and hazardous terrain remain in the same area for as long as your wicket’s dominion is in effect.

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the acid trait that deals damage, you can choose to deal bludgeoning damage instead of acid damage. When you Cast a Spell with the earth trait that would require a save, the creature takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speed for 1 round on a failure, or a –10-foot status penalty if it was a critical failure. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.54mC3SyjiHMKrioO]{Effect: Erosior}

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the acid trait
Access to at least one spell with the earth trait

Howl of Winter (Moderate).name: Howl of Winter (Moderate)
Howl of Winter (Moderate).description:
Activate 2 Interact, Strike

This spellgun somehow appears to be a naturally-formed pistol shaped icicle. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. This spellgun has a range increment of 30 feet. The spellgun blasts bone-chilling arctic wind that deals @Damage[7d6[cold]] damage, then melts.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed until the start of your next turn.

Success As critical success, except the target takes full damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty.

Shadow Draw.name: Shadow Draw
Shadow Draw.description:
Trigger Your turn begins.

Requirements You are in dim-light or darkness and are not wielding your shadow weapon.

You draw your shadow weapon in an instant from the darkness. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.pvQ5rY2zrtPI614F]{Interact} to draw your shadow weapon.

Warping (Greater).name: Warping (Greater)
Warping (Greater).description: Spells cast through a ring with this rune can arc and change at sharp angles, allowing you to avoid allies and hit enemies around corners. When you Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll spell, you can select up to two squares within 15 feet to be the new point of origin for the spell. The second square must be within 15 feet of the first square. Determine your spell's line of effect and line of sight from there, as well as whether creatures have cover against the spell. The target of the spell must still be within range of the chosen square.

Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf.name: Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf
Conspirator Dragonbreath Bladed Scarf.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (occult, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (occult, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Arcane Duelist's Gloves (Greater).name: Arcane Duelist's Gloves (Greater)
Arcane Duelist's Gloves (Greater).description: This pair of white gloves has an embroidered dueling pistol on its back, the barrel running the length of its ring and pointer finger. You can spend 10 minutes absorbing a spellgun into the embroidered pistol, retrieving an absorbed item, or swapping one spellgun for another. A pair of arcane duelist’s gloves can only contain up to two spellguns. You can activate an absorbed spellgun while at least one of your hands is empty as if you were holding it simply by pointing at the target with the embroidered fingers.

Magic Amulet (8th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (8th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (8th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 8th-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Aspect Morpher Dedication.name: Aspect Morpher Dedication
Aspect Morpher Dedication.description:
You are an aspect morpher, a caster who morphs their body to their whims with reckless abandon. You learn a common or uncommon 1st-rank spell with the polymorph trait that targets yourself from any tradition and you gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Q9mXTZs2CQoIe7NA]{Coalesce Form} focus spell. You cast each of these spells as spells of the spellcasting tradition you used to qualify for this archetype.

During your daily preparations, choose a 1st-rank spell with the polymorph trait that targets yourself and has a duration of 10 minutes or less. The spell you chose becomes the form you assume when you cast coalesce form until your next daily preparations. You can recover a Focus Point by using the Refocus activity by focusing on your anatomy and your physical form.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.u6D9FECs5ImNY5ic]{Aspect Morpher Archetype}

prerequisites.value: You can cast spells from spell slots

Elemental Shift.name: Elemental Shift
Elemental Shift.description:
You transform into an elemental force of nature. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.7uM4JwbEJVzFrkiH]{elemental aspect} to become your aspect battle form.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.ARrJ3NLQQRzneYjc]{Spell Effect: Elemental Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Soaring Shape+.name: Soaring Shape+
Soaring Shape+.description:
Wings free you from the shackles of the ground below. Add the bat and bird shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.NzXpEzcZAjuDTZjK]{Aerial Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.OWedlrKGsVZVkSnT]{Insect Shape}, you also add the wasp shape to your untamed form list. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Le30algCdKIsxmeK]{Ferocious Shape}, you also add the pterosaur shape to your untamed form list. Whenever you use untamed form to take a shape that grants you a specific Acrobatics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to Acrobatics checks.

You can add the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.rU0OMGjiOo6xc7BR]{Flier} aspect ability to any animal aspect or increase its fly Speed by 15 feet if it already had Flier.

Blood Spells.name: Blood Spells
Blood Spells.description: Those who study blood find that its power extends beyond conventional concepts of magical traditions. Add @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.VXUrO8TwRqBpNzdU]{Bloodspray Curse}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.TaaMEYdZXQXF0Sks]{Blood Vendetta}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.fBoiPXmcIO50OFFR]{Boil Blood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.Rhlm6BfbroWfLhSp]{Fountain of Blood}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.wAqvtJaxC5zpZyMa]{Hemophilia}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.owt2TQbEz1AZyKfr]{Gruesome Marionettist}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.5zeSxzDxMSr0wgSF]{Sanguine Mist}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.mz2gp9EaIa5xSphZ]{Siphoning Rivulet}, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.fd31tAHSSGXyOxW6]{Vampiric Exsanguination} to your spell list. You can thus potentially learn these spells even if they aren't normally on your tradition's spell list.

prerequisites.value: Haemothurge Dedication or Sanguimancer Dedication and the ability to cast spells from spell slots

Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar.name: Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar
Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Companion's Reprise.name: Companion's Reprise
Companion's Reprise.description:
Trigger Your mystic duo failed a Will Save.

Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your mystic link has made your mental connection so strong, you can help each other shake off ill effects that target your mental defenses. Your mystic duo can reroll the triggering save, but must use the new result, even if it's worse. Your mystic duo gains this reaction with its own frequency and the same limitations, with you as their mystic duo.

Undead Shift.name: Undead Shift
Undead Shift.description:
You transform into a ghost, skeleton, vampire, or zombie. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.XvhS51o90MK6TqiD]{undead aspect} to become your aspect battle form unless the form has the incorporeal trait. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.MXTfjiyueDwVyobC]{Spell Effect: Undead Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Heightened (6th) You can also select aspects with the incorporeal trait.

Elemental Shape+.name: Elemental Shape+
Elemental Shape+.description: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements. Add the shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.1K6AYGisvo9gqdhs]{Elemental Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list, and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.bK4rp20XuJRWGsEv]{Elemental Shift} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift} list. Whenever you're polymorphed into another shape using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to fire.

Advanced Sleuth.name: Advanced Sleuth
Advanced Sleuth.description: When your familiar Aids you on a check, you can choose to forgo the circumstance bonus it grants to instead roll the check twice, once with your modifier and once with your familiar’s modifier to the triggering check, using the higher of the results as your result. This is a fortune effect.

Sanguine Sculpting.name: Sanguine Sculpting
Sanguine Sculpting.description:
You inject a bit of blood into the magical framework of your spell in order to infuse it with malleable power. You use a single-action spellshape. When you Cast the Spell, you reduce your Hit Points by the rank of the spell you modified with the spellshape. This is not damage and thus cannot be reduced, resisted, or otherwise mitigated in any way otherwise the spell fails.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.HASFgAZ7spYleeaq]{Sanguimancer Dedication}, you can spend sanguimancy Hit Points equal to the rank of the spell instead.

Diabolic Dragonbreath Spiked Chain.name: Diabolic Dragonbreath Spiked Chain
Diabolic Dragonbreath Spiked Chain.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, unholy) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, unholy) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Savior.name: Savior
Savior.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of resplendence and life.

Wicket Traits healing, vitality

Threaded Magic When a creature within the area of your wicket’s dominion is restored to full Hit Points from one of your spells, it gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and a +2 status bonus to damage rolls for 1 round. This is an emotion and mental effect. The creature is then immune to this effect for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.h9V3P2bxgAdhMqGA]{Effect: Savior's Grace}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.ZpRDuMJLaverCMMM]{Effect: Savior's Grace Immunity}

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the healing and vitality traits that targets an undead, you can heal the creature normally even if the spell also has the vitality trait and it would normally be immune to healing effects. You gain a +2 status bonus against mental effects for 1 round when you remove the dying condition from a creature. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.4mOzpWqesb5d230W]{Effect: Savior's Tranquility}

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the healing trait
Access to at least one spell with the vitality trait

Duplicitous Forms.name: Duplicitous Forms
Duplicitous Forms.description: You are skilled at using multiple forms at once. You can choose two spells for your coalesce form during your daily preparations instead of one, allowing you to transform into either of the forms granted by your selections when you Cast the Spell.

Master Essence Spellcasting.name: Master Essence Spellcasting
Master Essence Spellcasting.description:
Instead of the normal @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.journals.JournalEntry.vx5FGEG34AxI2dow.JournalEntryPage.DOc3Pf8wmVxanTIv#master-spellcasting-feat]{Master Spellcasting Feat}, when using essence casting, the master spellcasting benefits are as follows: You become a master of spell attack rolls and spell DCs. You gain a 6th-rank spell slot, and your essence draw increases to 5 and your maximum essence pool increases to 6 if they were lower. If you have a spell repertoire, you can select a third spell from your repertoire as a signature spell. At 20th level, you gain a 7th-rank spell slot, and your essence draw increases to 6 and your maximum essence pool increases to 7 if they were lower.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.gWcA65AL89Y9Bcxr]{Essence Spellcasting Archetypes}

Initial Draw.name: Initial Draw
Initial Draw.description: Starting at 5th level, you draw an amount of essence up to your essence draw when you roll initiative. This upwelling of essence is instinctual and does not require any actions or effort on your part, nor can it be disrupted. While you can choose to draw less essence than your essence draw if you wish based on the situation, if for some reason you would be unable to act or to make any decisions, you draw in essence equal to your essence draw by default.

Essence Rebirth.name: Essence Rebirth
Essence Rebirth.description:
Starting at 3rd level, you can start your essence cycle again by casting a draw cantrip. In this way, an essence spellcaster can continue to cast spells throughout the encounter, cycling through several ranks of spells and a draw cantrip.

Example Playthrough

For example, a 17th-level sorcerer with an essence draw of 7 and a maximum essence pool of 9 currently has 7 essence. They could cast a 7th-rank essence spell, such as a 7th-rank @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.o6YCGx4lycsYpww4]{Haste} to start the fight with a strong benefit for their team, raising their essence to 8. Then on the next turn, they could cast an 8th-rank essence spell, maybe a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Oj1PJBMQD9vuwCv7]{Quandary} to trap a particularly annoying foe in a puzzle, raising their essence to 9. Then on the third turn, they could cast a 9th-rank essence spell, perhaps a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.10VcmSYNBrvBphu1]{Massacre} to wipe out the allies of the foe trapped in the quandary. At that point, they’ve completed their essence cycle, so they’d return to 0 essence and could use a draw cantrip, such as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kBhaPuzLUSwS6vVf]{Electric Arc}, to draw back up to 7 essence and start a second cycle.

Share Eldritch Energy.name: Share Eldritch Energy
Share Eldritch Energy.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active and your last action this turn was to Cast a Spell that damaged a creature.

The energy that flows along your Mystic Link imbues your mystic duo’s weapon with energy from your spells. Until the start of your next turn, your mystic duo deals additional damage with their unarmed attacks and wielded weapons equal to the rank of the required spell or half the rank of the required spell if the spell was a cantrip. The additional damage is the same type as the required spell.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.VPLqbAq4RcPaQfVZ]{Effect: Eldritch Energy}

Conspirator Dragonbreath Dagger.name: Conspirator Dragonbreath Dagger
Conspirator Dragonbreath Dagger.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (occult, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (occult, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Second Draw.name: Second Draw
Second Draw.description: Starting at 3rd level, after the first time your essence reaches 0 during an encounter, you can use a draw cantrip to draw essence a second time. If you didn’t experience an essence leak, your second draw is 1 higher than your usual essence draw.

Verdor.name: Verdor
Verdor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of verdant life and vegetation.

Wicket Traits plant, wood

Threaded Magic Choose 4 contiguous @Template[distance:5|type:square]{squares} within 30 feet. You create a small growth of plants and wood that provide lesser cover that lasts for as long as your wicket’s dominion remains in effect. If you choose the same square more than once with this effect, they provide standard cover instead of lesser cover.

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the plant or wood traits that would require a save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.eIcWbB5o3pP6OIMe]{Immobilized} for 1 round on a critical failure. The escape DC for this effect is your spell DC.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the plant trait
Access to at least one spell with the wood trait

Winter's Cold Embrace.name: Winter's Cold Embrace
Winter's Cold Embrace.description:
You create a darkness so cold and chilling that even those that would call the cold and darkness friend fear it. Light does not enter the area and any non-magical light sources, such as a torch or lantern, do not emanate any light while inside the area, even if their light radius would extend beyond the darkness. This also suppresses magical light of the spell's rank or lower. Light can't pass through, so creatures in the area can't see outside. From outside, it appears as a frosted globe of pure darkness. Creatures with darkvision cannot see through the darkness and creatures with greater darkness still treat the area as concealed. Creatures that end their turn in the area of darkness take 12d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. Creatures with immunities or resistance to cold damage take spirit damage instead if they do not possess darkvision or greater darkvision.

Heightened (+1) Increase the damage by 2d4.

Omnidisciplinary Battle Forms.name: Omnidisciplinary Battle Forms
Omnidisciplinary Battle Forms.description:
You reach across traditions and essences to call upon the impossible. Select a battle form spell from any spell tradition of a spell rank you can cast. You gain access to the spell as if it were a spell of your tradition and you can select that spell during your daily preparations for your coalesce form even though it is not a 1st-rank spell.

Special You can select this feat multiple times, each time selecting a new spell that would grant a battle form.

Horned Dragonbreath Longspear (Major).name: Horned Dragonbreath Longspear (Major)
Horned Dragonbreath Longspear (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Dragon Shift.name: Dragon Shift
Dragon Shift.description:
You transform into a dragon of your magical tradition. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.XaX4kPgcKyHxbVZS]{dragon aspect} of a tradition appropriate for its Magic of the Dragon to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.fFFQHKmFs2YBbHPK]{Spell Effect: Dragon Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Summon Monitor Aspect.name: Summon Monitor Aspect
Summon Monitor Aspect.description:
You call upon a monitor to aid you. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.C6JZEcra03J2ysI4]{monitor aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.13dSYGpF5Ujzcai3]{Monitor Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.e2a8jTjyee5htlUZ]{Spell Effect: Monitor Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.IOhLUVDS8YFWn6oS]{Summon Monitor Aspect}

Carrier.name: Carrier
Carrier.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.Ms8EVO2mNbr4Zp1i]{Item Delivery} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.9PsptrEoCC4QdM23]{Valet}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.BXssJhTJjKrfojwG]{Fast Movement}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.cT5octWchU4gjrhP]{Manual Dexterity}

Your familiar is adept at item transfer.

Advanced Carrier Your familiar can Interact with items up to 1 Bulk. It can use an additional action to move before it delivers the item when it uses item delivery or retrieve an additional item when it uses valet.

Reactive Aspect Transformation.name: Reactive Aspect Transformation
Reactive Aspect Transformation.description:
Trigger varies

You transform reflexively when in danger. You cast @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift} to transform into one shape granted by one of the prerequisite feats you have, depending on the trigger. Your shape's resistances and weaknesses apply against the triggering damage.

Trigger You fall 10 feet or more

Effect Choose a shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.lV8etIlOczlCbJ46]{Animal Shift} (aerial aspect only).

Trigger You take bludgeoning or poison damage

Effect Choose a primal dragon shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.d8OboK14CSqs7N7p]{Dragon Shift} that resists the triggering damage.

Trigger You take fire damage

Effect Choose a fire elemental shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.bK4rp20XuJRWGsEv]{Elemental Shift}.

Trigger You take poison damage

Effect Choose a shape from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.qH18jW3EMywavprR]{Plant Shift}.

prerequisites.value: Dragon Shape, Elemental Shape, Plant Shape, or Soaring Shape

Fuse Aspects.name: Fuse Aspects
Fuse Aspects.description: You combine two aspects into one. If your next action is to cast an aspect summon spell, you choose two aspects you know for the same aspect summon spell and summon a creature with the characteristics of both aspects. Choose one to be the base aspect. The fused aspect gains all of the skills, special abilities, traits, and actions of each of the chosen aspects, but uses the base statistics (such as Hit Points and save adjustments) of the base aspect. If a fused aspect grants contradictory statistics, special abilities, or actions, the spell automatically fails (subject to GM discretion), but you don’t consume any spell slots or Focus Points when you Cast the Spell.

prerequisites.value: You know at least two aspects for the same aspect summon spell

Esoteric Coordination.name: Esoteric Coordination
Esoteric Coordination.description:
Trigger You and your mystic duo roll initiative in the same encounter.

Requirements You and your mystic duo are within 30 feet of each other and were using the same exploration activity prior to rolling initiative.

The time you and your mystic duo have spent in tense situations together has given you both a preternatural sense of the other's intended actions in most situations, allowing you to decide which of you should act first. You use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.DCGRN0KjuuicApmh]{Mystic Link}. You and your mystic duo use the higher of your two rolls for each of your initiatives.

Dynamic Haunting Hymn.name: Dynamic Haunting Hymn
Dynamic Haunting Hymn.description:
You echo a jarring hymn that only creatures in the area can hear.

1 The area is a @Template[distance:5|type:burst] within 15 feet of you. Creatures within the area who fail a Fortitude save are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9PR9y0bi4JPKnHPR]{Deafened} until the beginning of your next turn (or for 1 minute on a critical failure). They are then temporarily immune to the one-action version of dynamic haunting hymn for 1 minute.

2 The hymn deals 1d8 sonic damage in a @Template[distance:15|type:line] with a basic Fortitude save. If a target critically fails the save, it's also deafened for 1 minute.

3 As the 2-action version, except the spell’s area is a @Template[distance:15|type:emanation].

Heightened (+2) The damage of the 2-action and 3-action versions of the spell increases by 1d8.

Allied Wicket.name: Allied Wicket
Allied Wicket.description:
Requirements Your most recent action was to cast a non-cantrip spell with one of your wicket traits.

You can protect your ally briefly by opening the magic within themselves as a brief form of protection. You grant an ally within 30 feet a +1 status bonus to saving throws against effects with your wicket traits until the end of your next turn.

Thurse Shift.name: Thurse Shift
Thurse Shift.description:
You transform into a giant or magical beast. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.YnKV7I548K8EH9JW]{thurse aspect} to become your aspect battle form. If you select a giant thurse aspect, you have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.RhhDWeuA1RBPLy1W]{Spell Effect: Thurse Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Magic Amulet (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (2nd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 2nd-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Essence Strike.name: Essence Strike
Essence Strike.description:
Requirements You aren’t temporarily immune to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Gb7SeieEvd0pL2Eh]{Sure Strike}.

You draw upon the surrounding essence to aim your next spell. The next time you make a spell attack roll before the end of your turn, roll it twice and use the better result. The attack ignores circumstance penalties to the attack roll and any flat check required due to the target being Concealed or Hidden. After using Essence Strike, you are temporarily immune to sure strike for 10 minutes.

Summon Plant Aspect.name: Summon Plant Aspect
Summon Plant Aspect.description:
You grow a plant creature to fight for you. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.qDuNt0YwJX8CTZ14]{plant aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.VJRMPhu1NYPvY0tz] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.CM5I6zG1L7Q5HamS]{Spell Effect: Plant Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.ioPu2AAAiw0ExO62]

Magic Amulet (1st-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (1st-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (1st-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 1st-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Unified Thread.name: Unified Thread
Unified Thread.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active.

The link you share with your companion has grown so strong you can act as one person for a short period of time. When you use this ability, you and your mystic duo gain four actions split between you and your mystic duo anyway you choose, though each of you must use at least one action. Your mystic duo takes these actions even though it is not their turn and then becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} for 1 round. Your mystic duo gains this activity with its own frequency and the same limitations, with you as their mystic duo.

Darkness is My Ally.name: Darkness is My Ally
Darkness is My Ally.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon.

Your control of shadow essence in the face of darkness is when you are most deadly. You make a Strike with your shadow weapon. If you and the target are both in either dim-light or darkness, the target is off-guard to your Strike.

Immobilizing (Greater).name: Immobilizing (Greater)
Immobilizing (Greater).description:
When you blast magic from a hand wearing this ring, it encrusts the enemy in magical ice, stone, or wood. Each rune specializes in either cold, earth, shadow, or wood, and the rune gains that trait.

When you critically succeed at a spell attack roll with a spell that has no duration and has the trait of the rune, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 1} until the end of your next turn unless it succeeds at a @Check[dc:34|type:fortitude] save.

If you critically strike a creature slowed by the Immobilizing rune with a second spell attack with the chosen trait, the creature must attempt an additional @Check[dc:34|type:fortitude|traits:incapacitation]. On a failure, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Slowed 2} instead of slowed 1 and extends the duration until the end of your next turn. On a critical failure the target is instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dTwPJuKgBQCMxixg]{Petrified} for 1 minute (this is an incapacitation effect).

Scourging (Greater).name: Scourging (Greater)
Scourging (Greater).description: Spells cast with a scouring ring leave lasting wounds on the target. Each rune specializes in either acid, electricity, fire, or physical damage and the ring gains the trait of the damage type or force if the damage type is physical. When you critically succeed at a spell attack roll with a spell that has no duration and deals the damage type of the rune, the target also takes @Damage[2d10[@item.flags.pf2e.rulesSelections.scourging.damageType, persistent]] persistent damage of the same type the spell would deal or bleed damage if the spell dealt physical damage. If the spell would already deal persistent damage, the DC to end the persistent damage increases by 2. Damage dealt from a spell attack roll modified by Veracious Spell ignores the target’s resistance (including the persistent damage done by this rune).

Magic Bell (5th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (5th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (5th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 5th-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Awaken Forbisen.name: Awaken Forbisen
Awaken Forbisen.description:
You empower the form of your familiar, instilling a permanent set of abilities based on your choice of powers.

Success The familiar permanently gains the abilities of the chosen forbisen, and you lose 2 freely selectable familiar abilities for as long as you have your current familiar.

Failure The familiar fails to catalyze. You can still select its abilities as normal.

Triplicate Casting.name: Triplicate Casting
Triplicate Casting.description: Your mastery over the inner workings of spells allows you to tease out their potential into small pieces, directing each fragment independently. Choose three different non-cantrip dynamic mastery spells that can be cast with one action, and Cast their one-action versions. When you do, you expend only one spell slot, using the rank of the highest-rank spell you Cast.

Adamantine Dragonbreath Maul (Greater).name: Adamantine Dragonbreath Maul (Greater)
Adamantine Dragonbreath Maul (Greater).description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Advanced Rowdy.name: Advanced Rowdy
Advanced Rowdy.description: Your familiar is treated as one size category larger for the purposes of creatures it could use Athletics checks against, allowing them to use Athletics maneuvers against creatures of appropriate size. You can select this ability more than once, each time increasing the effective size of the creature by one size category for the purposes of Athletics maneuvers.

Dynamic Void Warp.name: Dynamic Void Warp
Dynamic Void Warp.description:
You call upon the Void to harm life force.

1 Target a creature within 20 feet. If the creature fails the save, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn. The creature is then temporarily immune to the 1-action version of dynamic void warp for 1 minute.

2 You deal 2d4 void damage to a creature within 20 feet with a basic Fortitude save. If the creature critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

3 As the 2-action version, except the spell’s range is 60 feet. The target is also more likely to become enfeebled. On a failed save, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} on a critical failure).

Heightened (+1) The damage of the 2-action and 3-action versions of the spell increases by 1d4.

Summon Seer.name: Summon Seer
Summon Seer.description: Your experience with an eidolon makes you exceptional at harnessing aspects. You learn a summon spell that could summon a creature that shares a trait with your eidolon and add the spell to your spell repertoire permanently without counting towards spells in your repertoire and the spell is always a signature spell for you. You can select summon spells that do not share your eidolons traits if they would be closely related or connected to your eidolon in another way, such as the aspects of summon animal aspect if your eidolon is a beast eidolon (subject to GM discretion).

prerequisites.value: You are able to cast aspect spells

Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier (Major).name: Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier (Major)
Fortune Dragonbreath Rapier (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, force) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[force]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, force) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[force]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Old-Mage's Echo.name: Old-Mage's Echo
Old-Mage's Echo.description: Old-Mage Jatembe was the first of the great wizards to craft a spell that would punish an enemy spellcaster with magical feedback from their own castings, but he is not the last. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Q18KFDo3grt6tHaJ]{Old-Mage's Echo} focus spell.

Multidisciplinary Battle Forms.name: Multidisciplinary Battle Forms
Multidisciplinary Battle Forms.description:
Your aspects are not constrained to one tradition of magic, reaching into nearby essences to expand your magic. Select a tradition from the list below, determined by your spellcasting tradition. You gain access to a single spell cast from spell slots that grants a battle form from that tradition’s spell list as if it were a spell of your tradition and you can select that spell during your daily preparations for your coalesce form even though it is not a 1st-rank spell.

  • Arcane, Divine occult or primal

  • Occult, Primal arcane or divine

Special You can select this feat a second time, gaining the tradition you did not pick the first time.

Ferocious Shape+.name: Ferocious Shape+
Ferocious Shape+.description:
You've mastered the shape of dinosaurs. Add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.KhM8MhoUgoUjBMIz]{Dinosaur Form} to your untamed form list. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} to take a shape that grants you a specific Athletics modifier, you gain a +1 status bonus to your Athletics checks.

Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift}, increase the unarmed damage dice of the Strikes of animal shift by one step in mount or predator aspects.

Dynamic Lightning Bolt.name: Dynamic Lightning Bolt
Dynamic Lightning Bolt.description:
A bolt of lightning strikes outward from your hand, dealing electricity damage with a basic Reflex save.

1 Your lightning bolt is a 15-foot line that deals 4d4 electricity damage.

2 Your lightning bolt is a 60-foot line that deals 4d12 electricity damage.

3 Your lightning bolt is a 120-foot line that deals 4d12 electricity damage and zig-zags to strike more targets. Pick one square on the line, and change the line’s direction starting at that point. This can’t cause a creature to take damage from the spell multiple times.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4 for the 1-action version or 1d12 for the 2- and 3-action versions.

Skulker.name: Skulker
Skulker.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Intimidation), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.aEKA3YWekLhEhuV8]{Threat Display}

Your familiar is terrifying and helps you unnerve your enemies.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.zl1Z5XoLqwjpNWoI]{Advanced Skulker} If your familiar is hidden to a creature you attempt to Demoralize or it uses Demoralize against a creature it is hidden from, it can move or otherwise reveal itself as part of the action to grant a +2 circumstance bonus to the check. Your familiar must be within 30 feet of the target creature and able to act.

Summon Undead Aspect.name: Summon Undead Aspect
Summon Undead Aspect.description:
You conjure the undead to fight for you. You summon an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.XvhS51o90MK6TqiD]{undead aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.Ea3IHrVajNxwpg9V] @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.MXTfjiyueDwVyobC]{Spell Effect: Undead Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.maUS2WaDgrj8sLJm]{Summon Undead Aspect}

Dynamic Telekinetic Projectile.name: Dynamic Telekinetic Projectile
Dynamic Telekinetic Projectile.description:
You empower an object with kinetic energy, readying it to assault your foe with great speed.

1 Target a ranged weapon that you are holding. Until the end of your current turn, the range increment of the weapon increases by 10 feet.

2 (attack) You hurl a loose, unattended object that is within range and that has 1 Bulk or less at a target. Both the object and the target must be within 20 feet of you. Make a spell attack roll against the target's AC. If you hit, you deal 2d6 bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage—as appropriate for the object you hurled. No specific traits or magic properties of the hurled item affect the attack or the damage.

Critical Success You deal double damage.

Success You deal full damage.

3 (attack) As the 2-action version of the spell, except you can use your telekinesis to bank around corners or avoid cover. The object must be within 30 feet of you, while the creature is within 30 feet of the object. As long as the object’s square has line of effect to the creature, you do not need to have line of effect to the creature. Determine the creature’s cover based on the object’s square.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the 2-action and 3-action versions of the spell increases by 1d6.

Shadowsight.name: Shadowsight
Shadowsight.description: Your eyes are filled with shadows that dance, allowing you to see in even magical darkness. You gain greater darkvision.

Improved Mystic Link.name: Improved Mystic Link
Improved Mystic Link.description: Your bond is strengthened, unified through your essences across greater distances. The range of Mystic Link increases to 60 feet. In addition, you can communicate with each other telepathically as long as you are on the same plane, even if your mystic link is not active and you each always know the direction and distance from each other so long as you are on the same plane.

Terminus of Insight.name: Terminus of Insight
Terminus of Insight.description:
Trigger You complete a cycle.

The overflowing mental essence within you provides incredible insights.

Cycle 1 You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge on topics directly relevant to your encounter. You immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with a +2 circumstance bonus and you add your level to your check if you are untrained in the skill. Every time you cast a spell that would increase your essence you can Recall Knowledge as a free action just before casting the spell; if you do, you can change which spell you cast to another spell that would increase your essence.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonuses are +3, and if you get a critical failure on your Recall Knowledge you get a failure instead.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonuses are +4, and when you succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context. When you critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you get additional information or context or can ask an additional follow-up question (the GM chooses which).

Effect: Terminus of Life Temp HP.name: Effect: Terminus of Life Temp HP
Effect: Terminus of Life Temp HP.description:
Cycle 1 If you Cast a Spell that would increase your essence and doesn’t heal a creature, you or one of the spell’s targets of your choice gains 2 temporary Hit Points per spell rank or 4 temporary Hit Points per spell rank for an essence spell. You can choose to grant the temporary Hit Points instead of additional healing when using a healing spell if you wish to conserve your life reservoir.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the temporary Hit Points increases to 3 per spell rank or 6 per spell rank if it was an essence spell.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the temporary Hit Points increases to 4 per spell rank or 8 per spell rank if it was an essence spell.

Horned Dragonbreath Longspear.name: Horned Dragonbreath Longspear
Horned Dragonbreath Longspear.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance (Major).name: Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance (Major)
Empyreal Dragonbreath Lance (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, spirit) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[spirit]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar.description:

Activate—Eruption (mental, occult) 2
