Advanced Factotum.name: Advanced Factotum
Advanced Factotum.description: Your familiar can use its second opinion for any check to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}, even if it does not have the skilled familiar ability in the skill you used for Recall Knowledge.

Paired Shadows.name: Paired Shadows
Paired Shadows.description: You gain two shadow weapons. You have two shadow weapons instead of one. You treat your shadow as two weapons instead of one for all purposes, including effects that would rely on wielding a shadow weapon and imbuing them with runes. When you Interact to draw your shadow weapon, you can draw both weapons instead of one, wielding each in a separate hand when you do. You must select the same weapon type for both weapons when you Interact to draw two of your shadow weapons.

Draw Cantrips.name: Draw Cantrips
Draw Cantrips.description: Ordinary cantrips that use 2 actions or more (not focus cantrips, and not amped cantrips spending a Focus Point to increase their effect) are called draw cantrips. Whenever you cast a draw cantrip, you can increase your total essence up to your essence draw. For example, a 13th level wizard has an essence draw of 5, so casting a draw cantrip allows the wizard to increase their essence to an amount up to 5, no matter whether their current essence was 0, 1, 2, 3, or 4. If your essence is already equal to or higher than your essence draw, draw cantrips can increase your essence by 1 instead if you wish to do so. So the 13th level wizard in the example could use a draw cantrip to increase their essence from 5 to 6 or from 6 to 7.

Shadow's Betrayal.name: Shadow's Betrayal
Shadow's Betrayal.description:
You inject a small amount of magic into a foe’s shadow, causing it to rise off the ground and attack its caster. Choose a weapon the target is wielding or an unarmed attack it could use for a Strike and make a spell attack roll against the target’s AC. If the target is in dim light or darkness, they are off-guard to this spell attack roll. If you hit, you deal 2d8 damage to the creature of the same damage type as the chosen weapon or unarmed attack. If the chosen weapon or unarmed attack you chose deals multiple types of damage, you choose which damage type when you make your spell attack roll.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d8.

Volley My Ally.name: Volley My Ally
Volley My Ally.description:
You meld your ally into a ranged weapon you are holding for a combo assault. You imbue your ally into the required weapon and make a ranged Strike at a creature within the required weapon’s first range increment. Your ally then appears in a space adjacent to the target of your Strike (or the closest available space if there are no available adjacent spaces). If your ally could make a melee Strike at the end of this movement against the enemy you targeted with your Strike, it may spend its reaction to make a Strike against the enemy.

Heightened (+2) Increase the range of the Strike by 15 feet. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.YJIdJob10wXRNsVv]{Spell Effect: Volley My Ally Range}

Magic Tome (5th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (5th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (5th-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Rejuvenating Reservoir.name: Rejuvenating Reservoir
Rejuvenating Reservoir.description: You recover your reservoir of life essence especially quickly. Whenever you Refocus, you recover your entire reservoir of life essence.

Quick Siphon.name: Quick Siphon
Quick Siphon.description: A quick sip may not satiate you, but it can sustain you, and you’ve leveraged this to refill your blood supply quickly. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.CiewiBqUwe8O5gWu]{Quick Siphon} focus spell.

Atmosphor.name: Atmosphor
Atmosphor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of compressions of wind and sound.

Wicket Traits air, sonic

Threaded Magic When you Cast a Spell with the air trait, you can float. Replace your land Speed with an equal fly Speed until the end of your next turn. You can't rise more than a few inches above the ground when you @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.cS9nfDRGD83bNU1p]{Fly}. This means you can move above many types of difficult or hazardous terrain without moving slowly or being damaged, even though you can't fly without limit. You can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.d5I6018Mci2SWokk]{Leap}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.2HJ4yuEFY1Cast4h]{High Jump}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.JUvAvruz7yRQXfz2]{Long Jump}, and take similar actions, and use your fly Speed for any calculations that would normally require your land Speed. When you deafen a creature with a spell with the sonic trait, they are also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} as long as they are deafened or until they spend a single action with the concentrate trait to balance themselves.

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the air trait, you are no longer restricted with your Fly speed. If you already possess a fly Speed, you instead increase your fly Speed by 15 feet. If you would fall at the end of your turn, you instead float safely to the ground. When you Cast a Spell with the sonic trait that deals damage, you can choose to deal bludgeoning damage instead of sonic damage.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the air trait
Access to at least one spell with the sonic trait

Summon Dragon Aspect.name: Summon Dragon Aspect
Summon Dragon Aspect.description:
You call forth a dragon under your control. You summon a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.XaX4kPgcKyHxbVZS]{dragon aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.IdIHKlhbug40fjr8]{Dragon Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.fFFQHKmFs2YBbHPK]{Spell Effect: Dragon Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.GvjC0mbROC1FyiZp]{Summon Dragon Aspect}

Scissored Assault.name: Scissored Assault
Scissored Assault.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your ability to work together with your mystic duo is honed and perfected, allowing you to seamlessly combine your magic with their attacks. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that requires a spell attack roll, you instead imbue your mystic duo’s weapon or unarmed attack with the spell instead of the normal effects. The next Strike your mystic duo makes determines the effects of both the Strike and the spell, combining all damage for the purposes of calculating resistances. The Strike gains all the traits of the spell. Your mystic link must still be active when the Strike is made and the Strike must be made before the beginning of your next turn or the spell fizzles with no effect.

Mystic Duo Dedication.name: Mystic Duo Dedication
Mystic Duo Dedication.description:
You have practiced binding yourself to an ally with your magic. When you take this dedication, choose one willing, non-minion ally to act as your mystic duo. As part of your training in this archetype, you train your mystic duo in the necessary habits and techniques to use your abilities automatically; your mystic duo doesn't need to spend any feats of their own to grant the effects. You only gain the benefits of your mystic duo archetype feats if both you and your mystic duo are alive and conscious. You and your mystic duo are always aware of any conditions affecting either of you. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.DCGRN0KjuuicApmh]{Mystic Link} free action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.8LMwQ54HMAmRLLDK]{Mystic Duo}

Special Actions and activities you gain from this archetype have the trait matching the spell tradition you used to qualify for this archetype.

Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar (Gre.name: Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar (Greater)
Adamantine Dragonbreath Morningstar (Gre.description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. Activate—Eruption (primal) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[bludgeoning]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Scepter of Energy Ablation.name: Scepter of Energy Ablation
Scepter of Energy Ablation.description:
Scepters of this type are often made of heavy iron and have large hand guards similar to some swords.

Activate—Energy Ablation 1 (manipulate, spellshape)

If your next action is to Cast a Spell that deals at least one type of energy damage (acid, cold, electricity, fire, force, sonic, vitality, or void), you gain resistance to one energy type the spell could deal equal to the spell’s rank until the end of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.m8c2qvWRzj1FDY6c]{Effect: Energy Ablation}

Activate—Energy Abjection 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day;

Cost a spell slot of at least 2nd rank

You grant resistance to one energy damage type of your choosing to all allies within 30 feet, equal to double the rank of spell you expended. This last for a number of rounds equal to the rank of spell you expended. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.oo9MDcLeNtHCccRq]{Effect: Energy Abjection}

Animal Shift.name: Animal Shift
Animal Shift.description:
You transform into a powerful quadruped, predator, or aquatic creature, like a horse, lion, velociraptor, or shark. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.3K8036kor5oCkGQ5]{animal aspect} to be your aspect, but if your aspect grants a fly Speed it grants the Flier aspect ability instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.TLIkcaSk5Zx3iFjK]{Spell Effect: Animal Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Wicket Domain.name: Wicket Domain
Wicket Domain.description:
Your connection to wickets allows you to bypass even the gods themselves to access magic. You gain the initial domain spell for one of the domains associated with your wicket.

  • Ardor ambition, passion

  • Atmosphor air, freedom

  • Erosior earth, dust

  • Extingor cold, darkness

  • Fabricator disorientation, creation

  • Luminor fire, sun

  • Magnetor lightning, metal

  • Mortisor death, decay

  • Propulsor toil, water

  • Savior healing, protection

  • Verdor nature, wood

Special You can select this feat more than once, gaining the initial domain spell you didn’t select the first time when you select it again.

Scepter of Heightening.name: Scepter of Heightening
Scepter of Heightening.description:
Often made of polished burled wood, this rod allows the user to reach new heights of power, using the energy from one spell to temporarily make many of their spells more powerful.

Activate—Heighten Spell 1 (manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per hour

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell of at least 3 ranks below the highest rank spell slot you have, you treat the rank of the spell as 2 higher for the purposes of numerical effects based on its heightened rank, such as damage, healing, increased area, bonuses, or penalties. You do not gain any other effects associated with the heightened rank, such as being able to target more creatures or treating the spell as a higher rank for the purposes of counteracting or the incapacitation trait.

Activate—Height of Your Power 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Cost a spell slot of at least 4th rank

For the duration, you can use the Heighten spellshape from this rod as if it had a frequency of once per round instead of once per hour. This effect lasts for a number of rounds equal to the rank of the spell you expended.

Owned Magic.name: Owned Magic
Owned Magic.description: You identify magical effects that leverage powers similar to your own. When you observe a magical effect with traits associated with your wicket, you automatically identify that it has those traits. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.9q6niCXD6WbjagwP]{Know Thy Magic} reaction.

prerequisites.value: master in the skill associated with your spellcasting tradition

Luminor.name: Luminor
Luminor.description:
You pass magic threads through the wicket of brilliance and heat.

Wicket Traits fire, light

Threaded Magic All of your fire spells gain the light trait. When you successfully make a spell attack roll or a creature fails its save against a spell with the fire trait, the creature takes @Damage[@item.level[persistent,fire]]{persistent fire damage} equal to the rank of the spell. If the spell would already deal persistent fire damage, you instead increase the persistent fire damage by this amount.

Overwhelming Wicket When you Cast a Spell with the fire trait that deals damage, you can choose to deal spirit damage instead of fire damage. You can deal spirit damage instead of fire damage with your threaded magic. When you Cast a Spell with the light trait that would require a save, the creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.XgEqL1kFApUbl5Z2]{Blinded} for 1 round on a critical failure.

prerequisites.value: Access to at least one spell with the fire trait
Access to at least one spell with the light trait

Horned Dragonbreath Light Pick.name: Horned Dragonbreath Light Pick
Horned Dragonbreath Light Pick.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. Magic Tome (8th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Tome (8th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Tome (8th-Rank Essence Spell).description: A magic tome contains powerful knowledge of a given spell. Each tome contains a single spell, in every rank up to the listed rank. During preparation, an essence spellcaster can choose to attune to a magic tome or a magic staff, but not both. When held in hand, the essence spellcaster adds the spell to their prepared spells or repertoire spells at every rank up to the listed rank; for spellcasters with repertoires, this increases both their number of spell slots and their repertoire size to include the new spells.

Drown.name: Drown
Drown.description:
You summon a bubble of deoxygenated water around the target’s face, gills, or wherever they use to breathe. Creatures that do not need to breathe are unaffected by this spell. Air bubble can counteract drown, and vice versa.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –2 status penalty to all checks it makes with the auditory or linguistics traits it attempts until the end of its turn.

Failure The target must hold its breath or it begins suffocating. The target creature can Interact to attempt to remove the bubble, allowing it to attempt a new Fortitude save to end the effect.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target also halves the number of rounds it can hold its breath (minimum 0).

Eldritch Resilience.name: Eldritch Resilience
Eldritch Resilience.description:
Requirements Your mystic link is active.

Your link has grown so powerful that you are able to give some of the mystic energy of your spells as life force to your mystic duo. If your next action is to Cast a Spell, your mystic duo gains temporary hit points equal to twice the rank of the spell or the rank of the spell if the spell was a cantrip. These temporary Hit Points last as long as your mystic link is active.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.aazap1iOXQDvTUNc]{Effect: Eldritch Resilience}

Aberration Shift.name: Aberration Shift
Aberration Shift.description:
You transform into an entity of unspeakable nature. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.xDO6Iqzk8uT6l0U3]{entity aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.whmVZjlcusY18Z2r]

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Terminus of Soul.name: Terminus of Soul
Terminus of Soul.description:
Trigger You complete a essence cycle.

The overflowing spiritual essence cloaks your soul with powerful protection to avoid calamity.

Cycle 1 You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to savings throws until the end of the encounter. After you Cast a Spell that would increase essence, you can attempt another saving throw against an ongoing spell, effect, or condition that initially affected you during this encounter and that allowed a saving throw, using the result of the new saving throw instead if it’s better. If you do, you end your terminus effect and the next time you use Terminus of Soul you are at cycle 1.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonus increases to +3, and if you choose to end the effect early and roll a success on the new saving throw, you get a critical success instead.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonus increases to +4, and if you choose to end the effect early, you treat the result of your new saving throw as one degree of success better than the one you rolled.

Scepter of Quickening.name: Scepter of Quickening
Scepter of Quickening.description:
Scepters of this type are almost always made from stabilized quicksilver polished so that it glistens in the faintest light. Despite this, they always appear slightly out of focus, as if they are moving too fast to be seen in one glance.

Activate—Quickened Casting f (concentrate, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

If the next action you use is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

Activate—Hasten to Fight 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

Cost a spell slot of at least 8th rank

You and all allies within 30 feet are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.nlCjDvLMf2EkV2dl]{Quickened} for 1 minute and can use the extra action each round for only Strike and Stride actions.

Effect: Maintaining Incantations.name: Effect: Maintaining Incantations
Effect: Maintaining Incantations.description:
From @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.PBYpWbE3Ls4NiiSs]{Incantations} class feature.

Reduces your essence draw and essence pool by the amount on the effect counter.

Collective Cantrip.name: Collective Cantrip
Collective Cantrip.description: Your mystic duo is able to use some of your eldritch power for themselves. During your daily preparations, choose a common cantrip on your tradition’s spell list. Your mystic duo can cast this cantrip as long as your mystic link is active. For the purposes of this cantrip, their spell attack modifier and spell DC are equal to yours.

Fortune Dragonbreath Greatpick.name: Fortune Dragonbreath Greatpick
Fortune Dragonbreath Greatpick.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, force) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[force]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, force) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[force]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:23] save.

The pain of blood loss is a temporary cost in pursuit of great power. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.JaoqIFWtitfe1jhr]{Sanguine Siphon} action.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.5HLm2qhSCzUr090m]{Haemothurge and Bloodmagic Feats}

Siphoning Rivulet.name: Siphoning Rivulet
Siphoning Rivulet.description:
Trigger A creature within range takes persistent bleed damage

You seize hold of the target’s blood as it leaves its body, siphoning it through the air to yourself. The target increases the triggering bleed damage by 4d4, and you gain temporary Hit Points equal to the total bleed damage they took that lasts until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Rumbustious Robes.name: Rumbustious Robes
Rumbustious Robes.description:
Combining two time honored traditions among mages, these flowing robes are covered in symbols that represent the pandemonium they contain. The runes and symbols flow across the surface like oil on water. The expansive folds of the robe are in constant motion, only settling for a few moments after the robes' magics are activated. The robes contain massive pockets from which their chaos can be retrieved as well as useful items. The pockets of the robe tie to an extradimensional space that can hold 2 Bulk of items, none of which can have greater than 1 Bulk. These items do not count against your Bulk limit.

Activate—Ask and Receive 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per hour

You reach into your pockets, looking for a specific item of 1 Bulk or less attempting to conjure it from an unknown space by attempting a @Check[dc:5|type:flat]. If you are successful, you draw the item from your robe as part of this activity. The item must be a piece of adventuring gear (from the table on page 291 of Player Core 1 or other sources of adventuring gear), and can’t be a weapon, armor, alchemical item, magic item, or other treasure. It must be common with a level no higher than 8th level, and its Bulk must be 1 or less.

Activate—Pocket Full of Chaos 2 (concentrate, manipulate)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

You reach into the pocket and pull out a numbered parchment, stone, or other symbolic item appropriate for the robe which immediately transforms into pure chaos. Choose a target within 60 feet then roll a 1d20 on the following table to determine the effect. Any spell DC required is DC 34, and any spell attack roll required is +26. If the robe casts a spell on you, you don't get a saving throw or other defense against it.

Pocket Full of Chaos Table

[[/r d20]]

Effect

The chaos churns your stomach. You are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} for 1 minute.

You and the target swap places.

Advanced Carrier.name: Advanced Carrier
Advanced Carrier.description: Your familiar can Interact with items up to 1 Bulk. It can use an additional action to move before it delivers the item when it uses item delivery or retrieve an additional item when it uses valet.

Unstable Draw.name: Unstable Draw
Unstable Draw.description:
Starting at 5th level, you can choose to make an unstable draw, where you draw up to 1 more than your essence draw from a @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.jNOZkBE8sd1UhH8o]{Draw Cantrip} or from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.cYHvzy96aWk5n8yC]{Initial Draw}. An unstable draw is dangerous and almost always results in an essence leak: the exact result depends on a @Check[dc:10|type:flat].

Critical Success You can cast any essence spell with a rank up to your current essence (your normal essence draw + 1) normally. This might allow you to complete an essence cycle faster than would normally be possible.

Success You can cast any essence spell with a rank up to your current essence (your normal essence draw + 1), but regardless of the spell you cast, you experience an essence leak the next time you cast an essence spell.

Failure The only essence spells you can cast are two-action or three-action essence spells with a rank exactly equal to your current essence (your normal essence draw + 1), and when you cast it, you experience an essence leak.

Critical Failure As failure, and you are also stupefied 1 until you attempt to cast the essence spell and experience the essence leak.

prerequisites.value: You gain more than 2 slots per rank (e.g. this excludes Psychics)

Bloodstained Bandana (Moderate).name: Bloodstained Bandana (Moderate)
Bloodstained Bandana (Moderate).description:
This dark bandana is so stained and crusted with blood that it is no longer possible to tell what color or pattern it may have once had. Wearing this bandana heightens your sense of smell, but only for the scent of blood. You gain imprecise bloodsense with a range of 30 feet. Bloodsense allows you to detect living creatures that are taking persistent bleed damage or who have the dying or wounded condition. You also detect free-standing puddles or droplets of recently spilled blood. At the GM's discretion, living creatures without blood can't be detected with your bloodsense.

You reduce the flat check to target a concealed or hidden creature taking persistent bleed damage. The flat check for a concealed creature is reduced to 4, and for hidden to 8.

Magic Amulet (7th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Amulet (7th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Amulet (7th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic amulet holds the power of an incantation to keep a spell’s effect active beyond the essence’s normal bounds and without reducing your essence pool or requiring a lengthy incantation.

Activate—Extend Incantation f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 7th-rank or lower Essence Spell using an incantation, at the end of the incantation, you can adorn the amulet on the spell’s target (or on one of the spell’s targets if there are multiple, or on a prominent point in the location if the spell is cast on an area). This allows the spell’s effects to last as long as its duration and the amulet remains in place, without reducing your essence draw or essence pool and without ending any previous long incantations.

Master of Many.name: Master of Many
Master of Many.description: You are skilled at using multiple aspects at once. When you spend 3 actions to Cast a Spell with the summon trait, you Sustain one summon spell you have active. If you are at least 12th level, you can Sustain up to two summon spells you have active, and if you are at least 18th level, you can Sustain up to three summon spells you have active. When you Sustain a summon spell in this way, your summoned creature gains only a single action from your Sustain.

Bounded Terminus.name: Bounded Terminus
Bounded Terminus.description:
Starting at 5th level, you can gather your essence to use an even more powerful spell after your second draw as long as you didn’t experience an essence leak. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.tS7kdCVx6wmAkQ6G]{Terminus of Bounded Might} action and a single spell slot of your highest rank which can only be cast when you use Terminus of Bounded Might.

Other sources may introduce other termini, which you can choose instead of Terminus of Bounded Might above.

Traditional Coalescing.name: Traditional Coalescing
Traditional Coalescing.description: You can coalesce more complex forms of your tradition. Choose an aspect spell you can cast from your tradition. You can select that spell during your daily preparations for your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Q9mXTZs2CQoIe7NA]{Coalesce Form} even though it is not a 1st-rank spell.

Eidolon's Bretheren.description: You use your bond to your eidolon to empower your summons. You can target your aspect summons with summoner spells that would normally target an eidolon. In addition, you do not apply the cumulative penalty for using an aspect summon spell below your maximum rank.

prerequisites.value: You know at least one aspect summon spell as a summoner spell

Dragon Shape+.name: Dragon Shape+
Dragon Shape+.description: You can take on the shape of some of the world's most fearsome creatures. Add the shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.5c692cCcTDXjSEzk]{Dragon Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list, and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.d8OboK14CSqs7N7p]{Dragon Shift} shapes to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift} list. Whenever you're polymorphed into another form using untamed form, you gain resistance 5 to your choice of bludgeoning or poison.

Life Essence Reservoir.name: Life Essence Reservoir
Life Essence Reservoir.description:
You weave life essence when you cast healing spells. You have a reservoir of life essence equal to the max rank healing spell you have prepared or in your repertoire times 12. Each time you heal a creature with an essence spell, you reduce the reservoir by the same amount. You can never restore more Hit Points to a creature with your essence spells than you have Hit Points in your reservoir. Each time you Refocus, you also recover an amount of healing in your reservoir equal to your max rank healing spell times 4.

Unlike normal healing, you can always choose to heal less than the amount of healing your spell would grant to conserve your life essence; as a result, you can always choose to exclude creatures from gaining the healing from your healing spells, including enemies that would be in an area of effect for your essence healing spells. Spells that use Hit Point healing as a way to transfer Hit Points between two allies, such as spirit link, don’t require an expenditure from your life essence reservoir as long as they transfer an equal amount of Hit Points from you or a permanent ally (not a summoned creature or the like); any healing beyond the amount lost comes from the reservoir.

If you’d like to heal more, you can choose to accept the healer or grand healer adjustments. This decision is made at character creation and is permanent. If you choose the healer adjustment, you gain 1 fewer spell known or prepared, as appropriate for your class, in each of your essence spell ranks. In exchange you can cast your choice of heal, harm, or soothe at any spell rank as long as the spell you chose is on your spell list. Additionally, your reservoir size increases to your max rank healing spell times 18, and when you Refocus you recover an amount equal to your max heal times 6. The grand healer trade off doubles those costs and benefits, so you gain 2 fewer spells in each of your essence spell ranks, but in exchange you gain the benefits of the healer trade-off, and your reservoir size increases to your max heal times 24, and when you Refocus you recover and amount equal to your max heal times 8.

Special If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.classfeatures.gblTFUOgolqFS9v4]{Divine Font} class feature for harm or heal spells, you gain the grand healer benefits without trading off your slots. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.yyt2I2lGbRndXjbc]{Selective Energy} class feat and you choose not to exclude any creatures in the area of your area harm or heal spell, you can choose a single creature that would normally be healed by your area harm or heal spell. If you do, the creature is healed for the normal amount and does not reduce your life essence reservoir total (other creatures healed still reduce your reservoir, as normal). The creature is then temporarily immune to this effect for 1 day. If you have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.0PcVi7eav6PMLOPl]{Restorative Channel}, you can choose to gain the spells it grants at each of your ranks they could be cast instead of your grand healer benefits during your daily preparations.

Incantation Mastery.name: Incantation Mastery
Incantation Mastery.description:
Starting at 7th level, when you use an incantation for a spell of lower rank than your current essence draw, you can increase the casting time to 1 minute; if you do, and the spell doesn’t have a duration, you don’t reduce your essence draw or essence pool.

Additionally, you gain @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.LpUkBQ44fun0a4it]{Terminus of Renewal}, which can allow you to purge your incantations’ effects after an essence cycle. Keep in mind that if your essence draw was reduced to 0, you can’t cast essence spells and can’t complete a cycle to use Terminus of Renewal.

Choose two actions or activities the creature can take that have either the attack, manipulate, or move traits, one is prohibited and the other is directed. If the creature takes the prohibited action or activity, it takes 5d10 persistent bleed damage. If the creature takes the directed action or activity, it is immune to the bleed damage from this spell until the beginning of its next turn.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half the persistent bleed damage and the spell ends at the beginning of your next turn.

Failure The creature takes the full persistent bleed damage and the spell lasts for the duration.

Critical Failure As failure, except the creature takes double the persistent bleed damage.

Heightened (+1) The persistent bleed damage increases by 1d10.

Scepter of Greater Distances.name: Scepter of Greater Distances
Scepter of Greater Distances.description:
Sometimes mistaken for small staves, these scepters are made of bamboo or other fast growing plants.

Activate—Reach Spell 1 (manipulate, spellshape)

If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that has a range, increase that spell’s range by 30 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 30 feet. If you have the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.BWomK7EVY0WXxWgh]{Reach Spell} feat, you increase the range of the spell by 45 feet instead of 30.

Activate—Mobilize the Distance 3 (manipulate)

Frequency once per day;

Cost a spell slot of at least 2nd rank

You grant all allies within 30 feet a +10-foot status bonus to Speed and a +1 status bonus to DCs and checks against effects that would impart immobilized, grabbed, or restrained for a number of rounds equal to the rank of the spell you expended.

Precision.name: Precision
Precision.description:
Precision rings can channel a massive blast of energy into a single thin ray that packs all the punch of its regular spell.

Activate—Hone Spell 1 (spellshape) You contain your magic to a single target. If your next action is to Cast a Spell that targets an area and requires a Reflex or Fortitude save, you may instead target one creature within range by making a spell attack roll against the target’s AC. This makes the target the only creature that would be affected by the spell and the spell has no effect on a miss, the effects of a failure on a successful spell attack roll, or the effects of a critical failure on a critically successful spell attack roll. You apply the ring’s item bonus to your attack roll.

Essence Summoner.name: Essence Summoner
Essence Summoner.description: When you summon a creature using essence, you can infuse it with your essence and upgrade it as you build essence. Your creatures summoned with essence spells gain a +2 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, saving throws, and skill checks if they are from a spell with a rank 2 lower than your essence pool value, or a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, AC, saving throws, and skill checks if they are from a spell with a rank 1 lower than your essence pool value. Any creature you summoned from an essence spell can spend an action, which has the concentrate trait, to evolve into a creature from the same spell heightened 1 rank higher, as long as the new rank isn’t higher than your current essence value. When they do, they keep their current damage and negative conditions and effects but lose any beneficial effects, and their status bonus from this feat decreases accordingly. You also gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.WdGe0lMC1nSuYBbX]{Terminus of Summoning} action.

prerequisites.value: ability to cast at least one summon spell with essence
Essence Weaver Dedication or Aspect Caller Dedication or you're a Summoner

Insect Shape+.name: Insect Shape+
Insect Shape+.description:
Your understanding of life expands, allowing you to mimic a wider range of creatures. Add the shapes in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.XI6Lzd2B5pernkPd]{Insect Form} to your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.8RWfKConLYFZpQ9X]{Untamed Form} list. Whenever you use untamed form to polymorph into the non-flying insect shapes listed in pest form, the duration is 24 hours instead of 10 minutes.

Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.rgKYmYLZVA7KeMxL]{Untamed Aspect Shift}, increase the unarmed damage dice of the Strikes of animal shift by one step in aerial aspects.

Plant Shift.name: Plant Shift
Plant Shift.description:
You transform into a tree, flower, or fungus. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.qDuNt0YwJX8CTZ14]{plant aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.CM5I6zG1L7Q5HamS]{Spell Effect: Plant Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Second Terminus.name: Second Terminus
Second Terminus.description: You weave essence skillfully, allowing you to achieve more versatile results than your peers. You gain the second terminus action associated with your tradition.

Magic Chalice (5th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (5th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (5th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 5th-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Lucky Decision.name: Lucky Decision
Lucky Decision.description:
You know that destiny and fate are not something that is predetermined. As part of casting this spell roll a d20 and make note of the result. For the duration of the spell you gain the Your Good Luck and Their Bad Luck reactions. If you use either reaction the spell ends immediately.

Your Good Luck r (manipulate) Trigger You are about to attempt a non-secret attack roll, saving throw, or skill check; Effect You insert the fate you have made for yourself. Instead of rolling a d20, you use the result you rolled when casting this spell for your roll. This is a fortune effect.

Their Bad Luck r (manipulate) Trigger An enemy creature is about to attempt an attack roll, saving throw, or skill check; Effect You steal the creature's fate and insert your own. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target rolls their check with a –2 status penalty.

Failure The target uses your roll from this spell for the triggering roll and takes a –2 status penalty to the check.

Critical Failure As failure, except the status penalty is a –4 status penalty.

Propagating Arc.name: Propagating Arc
Propagating Arc.description:
Cackling energy flies from your fingertips leaping through targets until the area around the target is filled with electricity. You create an arc of electricity that deals 2d12 electricity damage to the target. If the target fails its save, each creature within 10 feet of the target also takes @Damage[(@item.level)d6[electricity]] damage with a basic Reflex save, or half this amount if the creature was further than 10 feet but within 20 feet of the target. There must be at least 1 creature within 10 feet of the target for you to deal damage to creatures other than the target.

Heightened (+1) The damage to the target increases by 1d12 and the damage to targets within 10 feet of the target increases by 1d6.

Seal the Wicket.name: Seal the Wicket
Seal the Wicket.description:
Trigger A creature Casts a Spell with one of your wicket’s associated traits.

Your spells are dominant against the paltry magic of others that would attempt that which is your forte. If you are a prepared caster, you expend a prepared spell with the triggering trait to counter the triggering creature's casting of a spell. If you are a spontaneous caster, you expend a spell slot for a rank you could Cast a Spell with the triggering trait.

You lose your spell slot as if you had cast the spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell.

Special This feat has the trait corresponding to the tradition of spells you cast (arcane, divine, primal, or occult).

Dynamic Daze.name: Dynamic Daze
Dynamic Daze.description:
You push into the target's mind and daze it with a mental jolt.

1 The spell’s range is 30 feet. On a failure, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} against the next attack you attempt against it before the end of your current turn. The creature is then temporarily immune to the one-action version of dynamic daze for one minute.

2 The spell’s range is 30 feet.The jolt deals 1d6 mental damage, with a basic Will save. If the target critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}.

3 As the two-action version, except the spell’s range is 60 feet. Additionally, if the target fails its save, it is also off-guard until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+2) For the two-action and three-action versions of the spell, the damage increases by 1d6.

Omen Dragonbreath Scythe.name: Omen Dragonbreath Scythe
Omen Dragonbreath Scythe.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (mental, occult) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (mental, occult) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Dynamic Breathe Fire.name: Dynamic Breathe Fire
Dynamic Breathe Fire.description:
A gout of flame sprays from your mouth. You deal fire damage to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save.

1 You deal 1d6 fire damage to creatures in a single @Template[type:square|distance:5] within 15 feet.

2 You deal 2d6 fire damage in a @Template[distance:15|type:line].

3 You deal 2d6 fire damage in a @Template[distance:30|type:cone].

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6 for the one-action version or by 2d6 for the two-action and three-action versions.

Untamed Aspect Shift.name: Untamed Aspect Shift
Untamed Aspect Shift.description:
You reach within for a different part of yourself, and you set it free, transforming your body into another form. You can polymorph into any form listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.TXZWyxFYuhQeQ5ue]{Pest Shift}, which lasts 10 minutes. All other untamed shift shapes last 1 minute. You can add more shapes to your untamed shift list with druid feats; your feat might grant you some or all of the shapes from a given polymorph spell.

When you transform into a shape granted by a spell, you gain all the effects of the shape you chose from a version of the spell heightened to untamed shift's rank. Untamed shift allows you to use your own shapeshifting training more easily than most polymorph spells. When you choose to use your own attack modifier while polymorphed instead of the form's default attack modifier, you gain a +2 status bonus to your attack rolls.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.WD6wY7bgKKn3qMyV]

Heightened (2nd) You can transform into shapes listed in @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.lV8etIlOczlCbJ46]{Animal Shift}.

Light Killer.name: Light Killer
Light Killer.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon.

Your shadow weapon snuffs light. Strike a creature with your shadow weapon. If your Strike is successful, you automatically attempt to counteract any light effects within a @Template[distance:30|type:emanation] of the target and your counteract check modifier is equal to your [[/r 1d20 - 10 + @actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value#Light Killer Counteract]]{class DC or spell DC – 10}, whichever is higher.

Wicket Infusion.name: Wicket Infusion
Wicket Infusion.description: You can infuse your spells that would not normally trigger your wicket behaviors. If your next action is to Cast a Spell from Focus Points or spell slots that does not have your wicket’s traits, it still triggers the effects of your tethered magic effects as if it had one of your wicket traits. The spell does not gain the chosen trait and you must select which trait to infuse when you use this spellshape.

Glutton For Blood.name: Glutton For Blood
Glutton For Blood.description: You are replenished in the presence of blood. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.cyNMibnSJlCoNJZr]{Glutton For Blood} focus spell.

Magic Chalice (8th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (8th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (8th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 8th-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Bloodstained Bandana.name: Bloodstained Bandana
Bloodstained Bandana.description: This dark bandana is so stained and crusted with blood that it is no longer possible to tell what color or pattern it may have once had. Wearing this bandana heightens your sense of smell, but only for the scent of blood. You gain vague bloodsense with a range of 30 feet. Bloodsense allows you to detect living creatures that are taking persistent bleed damage or who have the dying or wounded condition. You also detect free-standing puddles or droplets of recently spilled blood. At the GM's discretion, living creatures without blood can't be detected with your bloodsense.

Bleeding Spell.name: Bleeding Spell
Bleeding Spell.description: You have learned to make those inflicted by magic to bleed. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.fZntOuJKiFAVWB3h]{Bleeding Spell} spellshape.

prerequisites.value: the ability to cast spells from spell slots

Horned Dragonbreath Light Pick (Greater).name: Horned Dragonbreath Light Pick (Greater)
Horned Dragonbreath Light Pick (Greater).description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (primal, poison) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (primal, poison) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[poison]] damage with a @Check[fortitude|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Form Eschar.name: Form Eschar
Form Eschar.description:
Trigger A creature within 30 feet would take persistent bleed damage.

Your control over blood allows you to thicken and clot, not just steal and thin. The creature can immediately attempt the flat check to end the persistent bleed damage before they would take damage. They can still attempt the normal flat check after they take damage if they fail this check.

Righteous.name: Righteous
Righteous.description:
Righteous rings somehow evoke those worn by old heroes and legendary figures of bygone eras.

Activate—Justice Prevails R (holy)

Trigger You successfully hit an unholy creature with a spell modified by Veracious Spell.

You overpower the evil ways of your enemy. The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 2} until the start of your next turn.

Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar (Greater).name: Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar (Greater)
Omen Dragonbreath Scimitar (Greater).description:
This +2 greater striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (mental, occult) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (mental, occult) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Kinetic Tow.name: Kinetic Tow
Kinetic Tow.description:
You bind a creature with chains that swiftly contract. The target creature is drawn by an invisible chain towards another creature or object of your choice within 30 feet of the target, depending on its Fortitude save. This is forced movement.

Critical Success The target is unaffected and the spell ends.

Success The target is moved 10 feet towards the creature or object and then the spell ends.

Failure The target is moved 15 feet towards the creature or object and cannot move more than 30 feet from the creature. The creature can attempt a new Fortitude save against the effect by spending an Interact action to break the chain. The target can choose to use its modifier in Athletics for its Fortitude save.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target is moved 30 feet.

Dynamic Vitality Lash.name: Dynamic Vitality Lash
Dynamic Vitality Lash.description:
You demolish the target's corrupted essence with energy from Creation's Forge.

1 Target a creature within 20 feet. If the creature fails the save, they are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn. The creature is then temporarily immune to the 1-action version of dynamic vitality lash for 1 minute.

2 You deal 2d6 vitality damage to a creature within 20 feet with a basic Fortitude save. If the creature critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

3 As the 2-action version, except the spell’s range is 60 feet. Additionally, the lingering vital energy grants you 3 temporary Hit Points that last until the end of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.JKseCzuJR9F5ZN9q]{Spell Effect: Vitality Lash Temp HP}

Heightened (+1) The damage of the 2-action and 3-action versions of the spell increases by 1d6, and the temporary Hit Points granted by the 3-action version increase by 3.

Construct Override.name: Construct Override
Construct Override.description:
These three interlocking gears are encircled with copper wire that hangs off the handle of the weapon they are affixed to. Activating them allows you to temporarily gain control over a construct if you have managed to score a hit.

Activate—New Mind Protocol R (envision)

Trigger You have just critically succeeded at a Strike against a mindless creature with construct trait

The triggering creature must make a @Check[dc:28|type:fortitude] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1}

Failure The target has gained the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.9qGBRpbX9NEwtAAr]{Controlled} condition, with you as the controller until the end of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, except the target has the controlled condition for 1 minute. This is an incapacitation effect.

Advanced Entertainer.name: Advanced Entertainer
Advanced Entertainer.description: You can command your familiar to spend 2 actions to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform}, comparing its result to the Will DC of one observer. If your familiar succeeds, the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinated} by it for 1 round. If the observer is in a situation that demands immediate attention, such as combat, your familiar must critically succeed to fascinate it and the Perform action gains the incapacitation trait. You must choose which creature your familiar is trying to fascinate before the check is rolled, and the target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Diabolic Dragonbreath Greataxe (Major).name: Diabolic Dragonbreath Greataxe (Major)
Diabolic Dragonbreath Greataxe (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (divine, fire, unholy) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, unholy) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[fire]] damage with a @Check[reflex|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Umbral Slayer.name: Umbral Slayer
Umbral Slayer.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon in dim-light or darkness.

You leverage all of the shadows around you to kill your enemies. Make up to three melee Strikes with your shadow weapon against creatures within 30 feet of you that are in dim-light or darkness, each using your current multiple attack penalty. All of these Strikes must have a different target. If your shadow weapon doesn’t have the agile trait, each of the Strikes takes a –2 penalty.

Howl of Winter (Lesser).name: Howl of Winter (Lesser)
Howl of Winter (Lesser).description:
Activate 2 Interact, Strike

This spellgun somehow appears to be a naturally-formed pistol shaped icicle. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. This spellgun has a range increment of 30 feet. The spellgun blasts bone-chilling arctic wind that deals @Damage[2d6[cold]] damage, then melts.

Critical Success The target takes double damage and takes a –10-foot status penalty to its Speed until the end of the target's next turn.

Success As critical success, except the target takes full damage and takes a –5-foot status penalty.

Dynamic Shield.name: Dynamic Shield
Dynamic Shield.description:
You raise a magical shield of force, whose size and durability depend upon the number of actions you spend Casting the spell. This counts as using the Raise a Shield action, giving you a circumstance bonus to AC until the start of your next turn, but it doesn't require a hand to use.

While the spell is in effect, you can use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.jM72TjJ965jocBV8]{Shield Block} reaction with your magic shield. You can use the spell's reaction to reduce damage from any spell or magical effect, even if it doesn't deal physical damage. After you use Shield Block, the spell ends and you can't cast it again for 10 minutes.

1 The circumstance bonus to AC is +1 and the shield’s Hardness is 3. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.6wSXeRgBrodYOOyR]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Shield 1}

2 The circumstance bonus to AC is +2 and the shield’s Hardness is 7. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.eS7pZNCRasZ4DsQy]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Shield 2}

3 The circumstance bonus to AC is +4 and the shield’s Hardness is 9. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.Item.P73ulk5252swrJEB]{Spell Effect: Dynamic Shield 3}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.QF6RDlCoTvkVHRo4]{Effect: Shield Immunity}

Heightened (+2) The shield’s Hardness increases by 3 for the 1-action version, 7 for the 2-action version, or 9 for the 3-action version.

Xanderghul's Pride.name: Xanderghul's Pride
Xanderghul's Pride.description: The runelord Xanderghul was one of the greatest illusionists to ever live, using his magic to create a cult of followers who worshipped him as the Peacock Spirit; you have attained mastery over illusion magic similar to his. Whenever you cast an illusion spell, it cannot be disbelieved by interacting with it or using the Seek action unless the creature attempting to disbelieve it first succeeds at a Will save against your spell DC; if they fail this save, no amount of non-magical inspection will convince them your illusion is anything other than exactly what you have crafted it to appear as.

Summon Entity Aspect.name: Summon Entity Aspect
Summon Entity Aspect.description:
You summon an entity to do as you command. You summon an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.xDO6Iqzk8uT6l0U3]{entity aspect} that can be up to Medium in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.wRsUCpiKvEUlONAx]{Entity Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.whmVZjlcusY18Z2r]{Spell Effect: Entity Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.Macro.8aXsOzBSLPYSYOta]{Summon Entity Aspect}

Fused Aspect Form.name: Fused Aspect Form
Fused Aspect Form.description: You combine two aspects into one, releasing something new and unimagined into the world. If your next action is to cast an aspect battle form spell, you choose two aspects you could have assumed with the chosen spell and gain the characteristics of both aspects. Choose one to be the base aspect. You gain all of the skills, special abilities, traits, and actions of each of the chosen aspects, but use the base statistics (such as save adjustments) of the base aspect while in this battle form. If a fused aspect grants contradictory statistics, special abilities, or actions, the spell automatically fails (subject to GM discretion), but you don’t consume any spell slots or Focus Points when you Cast the Spell.

prerequisites.value: You know at least one aspect battle form spell

Effect: Terminus of Insight.name: Effect: Terminus of Insight
Effect: Terminus of Insight.description:
Cycle 1 You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge on topics directly relevant to your encounter. You immediately @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge} with a +2 circumstance bonus and you add your level to your check if you are untrained in the skill. Every time you cast a spell that would increase your essence you can Recall Knowledge as a free action just before casting the spell; if you do, you can change which spell you cast to another spell that would increase your essence.

Cycle 2 As cycle 1, except the circumstance bonuses are +3, and if you get a critical failure on your Recall Knowledge you get a failure instead.

Cycle 3 As cycle 2, except the circumstance bonuses are +4, and when you succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context. When you critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you get additional information or context or can ask an additional follow-up question (the GM chooses which).

Magic Bell (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (2nd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 2nd-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Descending Gloom.name: Descending Gloom
Descending Gloom.description:
Requirements You are wielding your shadow weapon.

You disperse your shadow into the area to create darkness. You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.AjLSHZSWQ90exdLo]{Dismiss} your shadow weapon, causing a burst of darkness within a @Template[distance:30|type:emanation], reducing light in the area from bright-light to dim-light or from dim-light to darkness for 1 minute or until you Interact to draw your shadow weapon.

Monitor Shift.name: Monitor Shift
Monitor Shift.description:
You transform into an aeon, aesir, protean, or psychopomp. When you Cast the Spell, you can choose any @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.C6JZEcra03J2ysI4]{monitor aspect} to become your aspect battle form. You have hands in this battle form and can take manipulate actions.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.e2a8jTjyee5htlUZ]{Spell Effect: Monitor Shift}

Heightened As per @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.s5plpLZzwemVg4RC] rules.

Mirage Dragonbreath Bec de Corbin (Major.name: Mirage Dragonbreath Bec de Corbin (Major)
Mirage Dragonbreath Bec de Corbin (Major.description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:60] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:35] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Umbral Escape.name: Umbral Escape
Umbral Escape.description:
You merge with your shadow and displace yourself to another shadow within range. Stride up to your Speed towards another creature or object with a shadow. You ignore difficult terrain during this Stride and can move along solid surfaces like walls or ceilings during this movement. You gain resistance 4 to all damage during this Stride. You are then temporarily immune for 1 minute.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.eWkhxt0nbPzpJ8IL]{Spell Effect: Umbral Escape}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.aldVMd3CVTex6IQ9]{Spell Effect: Umbral Escape Immunity}

Heightened (+1) Increase the resistance by 4.

Magic Bell (6th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (6th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (6th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 6th-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Perishing.name: Perishing
Perishing.description:
A ring which takes the life of those by rendering either the mind or the heart to ineptitude.

Activate—Die! r (concentrate, death, incapacitation)

Trigger You roll a natural 20 on a spell attack roll with spell attack with no duration that deals damage.

The target must succeed at a @Check[dc:37|type:fortitude] save or die by destroying its heart. This kills any creature except ones that don't require a heart to live. For creatures with multiple hearts, this usually kills the creature only if you destroy its last heart.

Signature Dynamism.name: Signature Dynamism
Signature Dynamism.description: You’ve practiced some of your spells so extensively that modifying them has become second nature. Three of your dynamic mastery spells become signature spells. If any of the dynamic mastery spells you chose were already signature spells, you can immediately retrain those signature spell selections.

Magic Chalice (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Chalice (2nd-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Chalice (2nd-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic chalice contains life-giving magic that allows a mortal body to withstand additional recovery magic in a short period.

Activate—Repeat Recovery f (manipulate)

Frequency once per day

If your next action is to Cast a 2nd-Rank or lower Essence Spell that heals, counteracts effects, reduces or removes conditions or afflictions, or the like, your essence spell doesn’t cost Hit Points from your life essence reservoir and ignores the typical 1 day temporary immunity for counteracting and removal spells (if the spell also has its own separate temporary immunity, this activation doesn’t remove it).

Dynamic Frostbite.name: Dynamic Frostbite
Dynamic Frostbite.description:
An orb of biting cold coalesces around your target, freezing its body.

1 A target within 60 feet takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds on a failure until the start of your next turn, or a –10-foot status penalty on a critical failure. It is then temporarily immune to the one-action version of dynamic frostbite for 1 minute.

2 The spell’s range is 30 feet. The target takes 2d4 cold damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target also gains weakness 1 to bludgeoning until the start of your next turn. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spell-effects.DdqWMj7cuf4S1bgr]{Spell Effect: Frostbite}

3 As the two-action version of the spell, except the range is 60 feet. Additionally, on a failure, the target is clumsy 1 until the end of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage of the spell’s two-action and three-action versions increases by 1d4 and the weakness on a critical failure increases by 1.

Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear.name: Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear
Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear.description:
This +1 striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. The weapon type, damage type of the weapon, and the damage type, save, and traits of its activations are dependent on the kind of dragonbreath it is made from. You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:15] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:23] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune.
