A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Hemophilia.name: Hemophilia
Hemophilia.description:
You cause the target’s blood to flow freely. Regardless of the result, the target is temporarily immune for 1 minute.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target gains weakness 1 to bleed damage.

Failure As success, except the first time the target takes bleed damage while the spell is active, it becomes drained 1 or increases its drained value by 1.

Critical Failure As failure, except the weakness to bleed damage is doubled.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.blEZMYfhAWP8iW8Q]{Spell Effect: Hemophilia}

Heightened (+1) The weakness to bleed damage increases by 1.

Chimerized Aspect Form.name: Chimerized Aspect Form
Chimerized Aspect Form.description:
You can create creatures that bend the laws of reality with impossible abilities and traits.

When you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.items.uT1fjeJqinVDb5ZH]{Fused Aspect Form}, you can select from the following effects instead of the normal effects:

  • You fuse three aspects of the same aspect battle form spell rather than just one.

  • You fuse two aspects from different aspect battle form spells rather than just one.

Arcane Duelist's Gloves.name: Arcane Duelist's Gloves
Arcane Duelist's Gloves.description: This pair of white gloves has an embroidered dueling pistol on its back, the barrel running the length of its ring and pointer finger. You can spend 10 minutes absorbing a spellgun into the embroidered pistol, retrieving an absorbed item, or swapping one spellgun for another. A pair of arcane duelist’s gloves can only contain one spellgun. You can activate an absorbed spellgun while at least one of your hands is empty as if you were holding it simply by pointing at the target with the embroidered fingers.

Summon Elemental Aspect.name: Summon Elemental Aspect
Summon Elemental Aspect.description:
You summon forth an elemental creature. You summon an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.journals.JournalEntry.2ywfGZz3We3np1MB.JournalEntryPage.7uM4JwbEJVzFrkiH]{elemental aspect} that can be up to Small in size.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.actors.bmXqQTbhXycBBnvy]{Elemental Aspect} @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.ARrJ3NLQQRzneYjc]{Spell Effect: Elemental Aspect Statistics}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.macros.Macro.wL8DVU1LATUKHevP]{Summon Elemental Aspect}

Aspect Adept.name: Aspect Adept
Aspect Adept.description:
You have mastered many aspects of a given spell. Choose an aspect summon spell you can cast. If you are a prepared caster, you can spend 10 minutes to empty one of your prepared spell slots and prepare the chosen aspect spell in its place. If you are a spontaneous caster, the aspect summon spell you chose is an additional signature spell for you.

Special If you are a wizard with the spell substitution thesis, once per day you can swap a spell you have prepared to the chosen aspect spell as a free action.

prerequisites.value: You know at least one aspect summon

Calling.name: Calling
Calling.description:
Your ring swirls with the energies and faces of those it would conjure.

Activate—Veracious Summon f (flourish, manipulate, spellshape)

Frequency once per 10 minutes

The ring’s magic guides your attack. If the next action you use is to Cast a Spell that would summon a creature capable of making Strikes, the summon gains a status bonus to its Strikes equal to your power ring’s item bonus. You cannot use Veracious Spell until the summon spell ends.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.vIXDS3gCZR0ftsyd]{Effect: Calling Ring Rune}

Wicket Conjurer.name: Wicket Conjurer
Wicket Conjurer.description:
You are able to call upon creatures associated with your wicket and call them to fight for you. You gain an additional spell slot of your highest rank, which you can use only to Cast a Spell associated with your wicket. You choose which spell when you gain this feat.

  • Ardor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.hs7h8f4Z1ZNdUt3s]{Summon Fey} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.29ytKctjg7qSW2ff]{Summon Fiend} (demon only)

  • Atmosphor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (air only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lTDixrrNKaCvLKwX]{Summon Celestial} (azata only)

  • Desolator @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (cold only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.e9UJoVYUd5kJWUpi]{Summon Giant} (frost giant only)

  • Erosior @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (earth only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct} (stone constructs only)

  • Fabricator @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.f8SBoXiXQjlCKqly]{Illusory Creature} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon} (mirage dragon only)

  • Luminor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (fire only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lTDixrrNKaCvLKwX]{Summon Celestial} (archon only)

  • Magnetor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (metal only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lKcsmeOrgHtK4xQa]{Summon Construct} (metal constructs only)

  • Mortisor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.9WGeBwIIbbUuWKq0]{Summon Undead} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.ZbEHglw5tkJ3grQZ]{Summon Monitor} (psychopomp only)

  • Propulsor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (water only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon} (fortune dragon only)

  • Savior @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lTDixrrNKaCvLKwX]{Summon Celestial} (angel only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.kghwmH3tQjMIhdH1]{Summon Dragon} (empyreal dragon only)

  • Verdor @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.jSRAyd57kd4WZ4yE]{Summon Plant or Fungus} (plant only) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.lpT6LotUaQPfinjj]{Summon Elemental} (wood only)

Bewilder.name: Bewilder
Bewilder.description:
Your magic overwhelms the target's senses, swapping faces, silhouettes, voices, and scents of nearby creatures with ones from their memories. The target believes everyone might be their friend and is wary of attacking the wrong creature. Any time they attempt a hostile action, they must attempt a @Check[type:flat|dc:6], failing to perform the hostile action on a failure. If the creature fails to complete a hostile action against another creature due to this spell, it treats the creature it targeted with the hostile action as its ally until its next turn.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is affected until the end of their next turn.

Failure The target is affected for the duration of the spell, but it can attempt a Will save at the end of each of its turns. On a success, the spell ends.

Critical Failure The target is affected for the duration of the spell and the DC for the flat check is increased to @Check[type:flat|dc:11]{ }.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.sYWd0qLWCwEoht63]{Spell Effect: Bewilder}

Heightened (8th) You can target up to 10 creatures.

Empyreal Dragonbreath Greatsword.description:

Activate—Eruption (divine, fire, spirit) 2

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Command Shadows.name: Command Shadows
Command Shadows.description:
You call a shadow to your aid. Choose a creature within 30 feet that has a shadow. If you choose an enemy creature, the creature can attempt a @Check[type:will|dc:resolve(@actor.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)] save against the effect using your class DC or spell DC for the save, whichever is higher, keeping control of its shadow on a success. The shadow appears in a space adjacent to the target creature and you gain the use of the shadow for 1 minute and the target loses their shadow during this time. The target is then temporarily immune to Command Shadows for 1 hour.

The shadow is the same size as the creature you targeted, but its space can be occupied by other creatures, it cannot speak, communicate, or interact with objects, and it can move along any solid surface. You can direct the target’s shadow with a single action with the concentrate trait to move the shadow up to 30 feet along a solid surface. It provides flanking for you and your allies from spaces it occupies.

You can Dismiss the shadow, and if you do, it deals @Damage[(@actor.level / 2)d6[void]] damage to all creatures within the shadow’s space with a basic Fortitude save. This damage increases by 1d6 at 8th level and every 2 levels thereafter.

Accelerated Incantations.name: Accelerated Incantations
Accelerated Incantations.description: You can perform the lengthier forms of incantations more quickly than normal when casting weaker spells. When you cast an incantation with a rank below your essence draw, it only takes 30 seconds instead of 1 minute to avoid reducing your essence draw and pool. Additionally, when you cast a long incantation, reduce the incantation time by 10 minutes for each rank below your essence pool value, to a minimum of 10 minutes for spells of 5 or more ranks below your essence pool value.

Advanced Assistant.name: Advanced Assistant
Advanced Assistant.description: Your familiar can wield tools up to 1 Bulk instead of up to L bulk. Your familiar can use actions that would require being trained proficiency for its selection of skilled.

Iron Heart.name: Iron Heart
Iron Heart.description:
A small hand forged iron heart with a leather cord wrapped around, acts a connection between you and an ally, and allows you to restore some of their hit points in their most dire moment.

Activate—Power of Heart R (envision)

Trigger An ally within 60 feet of you that you can see has just gained the dying condition or had their dying condition increased

You snap the heart from its cord, sending some of your hit points to your ally. Your ally regains @Damage[2d8[healing]] hit points, and you lose the same number of Hit Points. You cannot mitigate this loss of Hit Points with resistances, immunities, or temporary Hit Points. If this loss of Hit Points would cause you to gain the dying condition, your ally gains an additional @Damage[2d8[healing]] Hit Points.

Veil of Darkness.name: Veil of Darkness
Veil of Darkness.description:
Trigger You critically succeed at a Strike with your shadow weapon against a creature with low-light vision, darkvision, or greater darkvision.

You place a veil on the target of a shadow so dark it interferes with their vision. You Dismiss your shadow weapon and the triggering creature’s ability to see in the dark is reduced by one step, from greater darkvision to darkvision, from darkvision to low-light vision, or from low-light vision to no low-light vision until the end of your next turn.

Magic Bell (4th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (4th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (4th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 4th-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Cyclical Summoning.name: Cyclical Summoning
Cyclical Summoning.description:
Trigger Your summon would be banished from being reduced to 0 Hit Points.

Requirements You could cast a summon spell.

You hold the vague form of the summon, filling it with more magic energy to continue the fight. You cast the required spell, with the new summon appearing in the space of the triggered summon as it is banished. The summon does not gain any actions from being summoned in this way, but gains actions as normal if Sustained on subsequent turns.

Eyes of Shadow.name: Eyes of Shadow
Eyes of Shadow.description: You empower your allies with the essences of shadow, lending its aid to their perceptions. You Dismiss your shadow weapon and grant darkvision to one creature within 30 feet for 1 minute or until you Interact to draw your shadow weapon. The creature is then immune to this effect for 10 minutes.

Advanced Domain Wicketeer.name: Advanced Domain Wicketeer
Advanced Domain Wicketeer.description:
You further excel at your depth of knowledge, diving deeper into the divine threads of magic. You gain an advanced domain spell from one of your domains for which you have an initial domain spell.

Special You can select this feat multiple times. Each time, you must select a different advanced domain spell.

Wordsmith.name: Wordsmith
Wordsmith.description:
Required Number of Abilities 2

Granted Abilities @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.7ZxPS0UU7pf7wjp0]{Ambassador}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.jevzf9JbJJibpqaI]{Skilled} (Diplomacy), @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.familiar-abilities.zyMRLQnFCQVpltiR]{Speech}

Your familiar has a way with words.

Advanced Wordsmith When your familiar Aids you on a check, you can choose to forgo the circumstance bonus it grants to instead roll the check twice, once with your modifier and once with your familiar’s modifier to the triggering check, using the higher of the results as your result. This is a fortune effect.

Adamantine Dragonbreath Maul (Major).name: Adamantine Dragonbreath Maul (Major)
Adamantine Dragonbreath Maul (Major).description:

Activate—Eruption (primal) 2

Mirage Dragonbreath Dancer's Spear (Grea.description:

Your GM may add dragonbreath weapons made from other dragon types, or made in unusual weapon shapes, such as lines or bursts, as appropriate for the dragon’s type. The dragonbreath weapon can be activated once per minute, using one of the following activations.

Activate—Unleash Dragonbreath (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You swing the dragonbreath weapon in an arc, unleashing the frozen dragonbreath in a @Template[cone|distance:30] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:27] save.

Activate—Eruption (arcane, emotion, mental) 2

You slam the dragonbreath weapon into the ground, causing an explosion of dragonbreath in a @Template[emanation|distance:5] that does @Damage[((@item.system.runes.striking + 1) * 2)d6[mental]] damage with a @Check[will|dc:27] save.

Special The damage of the activations increases to 6d6 if the dragonbreath weapon has a greater striking rune, or 8d6 if it has a major striking rune. The save DC increases to 27 if the dragonbreath weapon has a +2 potency rune, or to 35 with a +3 potency rune. A wielder with the dragonblood versatile heritage with an exemplar matching the dragon type the dragonbreath weapon is made from can choose to use the higher of their class DC or spell DC as the item DC.

Channel Essence Leak.name: Channel Essence Leak
Channel Essence Leak.description:
When your magic’s essence leaks, you channel the resulting spill, gaining a useful edge from it. When you cause an essence leak, either you gain a +1 status bonus to AC and saving throws until the end of your next turn or a creature affected by the spell causing the leak takes a –1 status penalty to AC and saving throws until the end of your next turn, your choice.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.ehRD6fl2IfuURuaM]{Effect: Channel Essence Leak}

Magic Bell (8th-Rank Essence Spell).name: Magic Bell (8th-Rank Essence Spell)
Magic Bell (8th-Rank Essence Spell).description:
A magic bell contains special magical intonations and pitches, allowing it to provide the full benefit of an incantation in a brief moment.

Activate—Cast a Spell

Frequency once per day

You Cast an 8th-Rank or lower Essence Spell as though using an incantation but using its normal casting time, without needing to increase it and without reducing your essence draw or essence pool. When you cast an essence spell using the magic bell, it doesn’t require a particular amount of essence or affect your essence pool in any way, as normal for an incantation; for instance, your essence doesn’t increase by 1 or cycle to 0. If you use the magic bell during an encounter to cast a spell with a duration, the duration lasts its normal duration or until the end of the encounter (as normal for essence spells cast during an encounter), whichever comes first.

Weave Conduit.name: Weave Conduit
Weave Conduit.description:
When you become a conduit for your magic’s essences, you gain additional benefits from the specific essences that make up your tradition’s magic. Whenever you use @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-team-plus-magic.misc.GMpbfdVHBUaiIwSy]{Essence Conduit}, choose a benefit based on one of the two essences matching your tradition (the essences from your terminus actions).

Life You gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level that last until the end of your next turn.

Matter You Step or Stride up to half your Speed (if you have a climb, swim, or fly Speed you can use the appropriate move action instead).

Mind You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.1OagaWtBpVXExToo]{Recall Knowledge}.

Spirit You @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} and gain a spiritsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet that lasts until the end of your next turn. Spiritsense enables you to sense the spirits of creatures, including living creatures, most non-mindless undead, and haunts within the listed range.

Omen Dragonbreath Scythe (Major).description:
This +3 major striking weapon is made of magically frozen dragonbreath and its handle is wrapped in dragon scales. They are often crafted by dragons of their own breath weapons and shed scales for their favored servants. Advanced Skulker.name: Advanced Skulker
Advanced Skulker.description: If your familiar is hidden to a creature you attempt to Demoralize or it uses Demoralize against a creature it is hidden from, it can move or otherwise reveal itself as part of the action to grant a +2 circumstance bonus to the check. Your familiar must be within 30 feet of the target creature and able to act.

Ramming.name: Ramming
Ramming.description: Ramming rings shoot foes rocketing away. Spell attacks gain the razing trait. On a critically successful spell attack against a creature, the target must also make a @Check[dc:22|type:fortitude] save or be pushed back 10 feet from the origin of the spell.
